## Write the model stg_acq__conditions
Domain: conditions. Acquired data format: claims export (CARIN consumer-directed payer data, one row per claim line). Raw schema: raw_claims.
## Staging contract (columns and types your model must return)
condition_start_date DATE
condition_stop_date DATE
patient_id VARCHAR
encounter_id VARCHAR
condition_code VARCHAR
condition_description VARCHAR
## The acquirer's staging model stg_synthea__conditions (it reads the acquirer's own CSV source; shown for its conventions)
```sql
{% set column_names = 
    dbt_utils.get_filtered_columns_in_relation( source('synthea', 'conditions') ) 
%}


WITH cte_conditions_lower AS (

    SELECT
        {{ lowercase_columns(column_names) }}
    FROM {{ source('synthea','conditions') }}
)

, cte_conditions_rename AS (

    SELECT
        {{ adapter.quote("start") }} AS condition_start_date
        , {{ adapter.quote("stop") }} AS condition_stop_date
        , patient AS patient_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , code AS condition_code
        , description AS condition_description
    FROM cte_conditions_lower

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_conditions_rename
```

```sql
        cast("BASE_COST" as double)                                   as medication_base_cost,
        cast("PAYER_COVERAGE" as double)                              as medication_payer_coverage,
        cast(cast("DISPENSES" as double) as integer)                 as dispenses,
        cast("TOTALCOST" as double)                                   as medication_total_cost,
        case
            when "REASONCODE" is not null
            then regexp_replace("REASONCODE", '^[^:]*:', '')
        end                                                          as medication_reason_code,
        "REASONDESCRIPTION"                                           as medication_reason_description
    from source_medications
),

final as (
    select
        medication_start_datetime,
        cast(medication_start_datetime as date)      as medication_start_date,
        medication_stop_datetime,
        cast(medication_stop_datetime as date)       as medication_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_id,
        medication_code,
        medication_description,
        medication_base_cost,
        medication_payer_coverage,
        dispenses,
        medication_total_cost,
        medication_reason_code,
        medication_reason_description
    from renamed
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
with
    src as (
        select
            id,
            resource
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
    ),

    extracted as (
        select
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') as start_str,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')   as end_str,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')    as subject_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') as encounter_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')  as proc_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            ) as proc_desc,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].code')    as reason_code,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') as reason_desc
        from src
    ),

    transformed as (
        select
            cast(start_str as timestamp)                           as procedure_start_datetime,
            cast(end_str   as timestamp)                           as procedure_stop_datetime,
            regexp_extract(subject_ref,  'urn:uuid:(.*)', 1)        as patient_id,
            regexp_extract(encounter_ref,'urn:uuid:(.*)', 1)        as encounter_id,
            proc_code                                               as procedure_code,
            proc_desc                                               as procedure_description,
            null::double                                            as procedure_base_cost,
            reason_code                                             as procedure_reason_code,
            reason_desc                                             as procedure_reason_description
        from extracted
    )

select
    procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime   as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
from transformed
```

```sql
{{-
    /*  stg_acq__patients
        Transform raw FHIR STU3 Patient resources into the staging contract
        used by the acquirer.  One row per source patient, columns match
        stg_synthea__patients exactly.
    */
-}}

with source_patients as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

stg as (
    select
        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')                                            as patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date)                      as birth_date,
        cast(nullif(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), '') as timestamp)::date
                                                                                     as death_date,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[1].value')                           as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value')                           as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value')                           as passport_number,

        -- name components
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')                              as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                               as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family')                                as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')                              as patient_suffix,
        -- maiden name – second name entry (use = "maiden") – may be null
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[1].family')                                as maiden_name,

        -- demographic fields
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                  as marital_status,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString')        as race,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString')        as ethnicity,
        case json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else upper(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'),1,1))
        end                                                                            as patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city state country from the birthPlace extension, index 4)
        concat_ws(' ',
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                              as birthplace,

        -- address
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')                            as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city')                               as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state')                              as patient_state,
        null                                                                            as patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                        as patient_zip,

        -- geolocation (first extension of address holds latitude/longitude)
        cast(nullif(json_extract_string(resource,
                 '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[0].valueDecimal'), '') as double) as patient_latitude,
        cast(nullif(json_extract_string(resource,
                 '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[1].valueDecimal'), '') as double) as patient_longitude,

        -- financial fields – not present in the FHIR payload
        null::double                                                                    as healthcare_expenses,
        null::double                                                                    as healthcare_coverage
    from source_patients
)

select *
from stg
```

```sql
        -- patient identifier from subject.reference (urn:uuid:<id>)

        -- encounter identifier from encounter.reference (urn:uuid:<id>)
        regexp_extract(

            'urn:uuid:(.*)', 1
        ) as encounter_id,

        -- condition code (SNOMED) from code.coding[0].code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as condition_code,

        -- description prefers code.text, fallback to coding display
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),

        ) as condition_description
```

```sql
WITH
-- raw observations
raw_obs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

-- top‑level observations that have a direct value (not just components)
top_obs AS (
    SELECT
        -- datetime (use effectiveDateTime if present, else issued)
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.issued')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        )                                   AS observation_datetime,
        -- patient and encounter IDs (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS encounter_id,
        -- category code (first element)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_category,
        -- observation code (first coding)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_code,
        -- description – prefer the free‑text, fall back to coding display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                   AS observation_description,
        -- value – numeric, coded, or plain string
        COALESCE(
            CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS VARCHAR),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
        )                                   AS observation_value,
        -- units – only for quantity values
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
                                            AS observation_units,
        -- value type
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw_obs
    WHERE
        -- keep rows that actually have a value at the top level
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
        OR json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL
        OR json_extract(resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL
),

-- component observations – each component becomes its own row
component_obs AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.issued')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        )                                   AS observation_datetime,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_category,
        -- component code
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                   AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS VARCHAR),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString')
        )                                   AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
                                            AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CAST(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw_obs
    -- explode the component array (if any)
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')
    ) AS comp(value) ON TRUE
    WHERE comp.value IS NOT NULL
),

-- combine top‑level and component rows
all_obs AS (
    SELECT * FROM top_obs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_obs
),

-- add the observation_date column (date part of the timestamp)
final_obs AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        observation_value,
        observation_units,
        observation_value_type
    FROM all_obs
)

SELECT *
FROM final_obs
```

```sql
WITH source_enc AS (
    SELECT
        Id AS encounter_id,
        CAST("START" AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST("STOP" AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        PATIENT AS patient_id,
        ORGANIZATION AS organization_id,
        PROVIDER AS provider_id,
        PAYER AS payer_id,
        ENCOUNTERCLASS,
        CODE,
        DESCRIPTION AS encounter_description,
        BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST,
        TOTAL_CLAIM_COST,
        PAYER_COVERAGE,
        REASONCODE,
        REASONDESCRIPTION
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }}
),

class_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        cm.standard_value AS encounter_class
    FROM source_enc se
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }} cm
        ON cm.list_name = 'encounter_class'
        AND cm.local_code = se.ENCOUNTERCLASS
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)                                   AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    COALESCE(CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE), CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE))
                                                                           AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    CASE
        WHEN CODE LIKE 'SCT:%' THEN SUBSTR(CODE, 5)
        ELSE CODE
    END                                                                    AS encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    CAST(BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST AS DOUBLE)                                     AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(TOTAL_CLAIM_COST AS DOUBLE)                                        AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(PAYER_COVERAGE AS DOUBLE)                                          AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    CASE
        WHEN REASONCODE LIKE 'SCT:%' THEN SUBSTR(REASONCODE, 5)
        ELSE REASONCODE
    END                                                                    AS encounter_reason_code,
    REASONDESCRIPTION                                                       AS encounter_reason_description
FROM class_mapped
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
{{--
stg_acq__observations
--}}

with raw as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

-- rows derived from Observation.component[]
component_rows as (
    select
        cast(resource->>'$.effectiveDateTime' as timestamp)               as observation_datetime,
        cast(resource->>'$.effectiveDateTime' as date)                    as observation_date,
        replace(resource->>'$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '')        as patient_id,
        replace(resource->>'$.encounter.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '')      as encounter_id,
        resource->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code'                         as observation_category,
        comp.value->>'$.code.coding[0].code'                              as observation_code,
        replace(
            coalesce(
                comp.value->>'$.code.text',
                comp.value->>'$.code.coding[0].display'
            ), ',', ' '
        )                                                                 as observation_description,
        case
            when comp.value->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then
                printf('%.1f', (comp.value->>'$.valueQuantity.value')::double)
            when comp.value->'$.valueCodeableConcept' is not null then
                replace(comp.value->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display', ',', ' ')
            when comp.value->'$.valueString' is not null then
                replace(comp.value->>'$.valueString', ',', ' ')
            else null
        end                                                               as observation_value,
        case
            when comp.value->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then
                comp.value->>'$.valueQuantity.unit'
            else null
        end                                                               as observation_units,
        case
            when comp.value->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                               as observation_value_type
    from raw,
    lateral json_each(resource->'$.component') as comp
    where json_type(resource->'$.component') = 'array'
),

-- rows for Observations without components
simple_rows as (
    select
        cast(resource->>'$.effectiveDateTime' as timestamp)               as observation_datetime,
        cast(resource->>'$.effectiveDateTime' as date)                    as observation_date,
        replace(resource->>'$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '')        as patient_id,
        replace(resource->>'$.encounter.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '')      as encounter_id,
        resource->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code'                         as observation_category,
        resource->>'$.code.coding[0].code'                                as observation_code,
        replace(
            coalesce(
                resource->>'$.code.text',
                resource->>'$.code.coding[0].display'
            ), ',', ' '
        )                                                                 as observation_description,
        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then
                printf('%.1f', (resource->>'$.valueQuantity.value')::double)
            when resource->'$.valueCodeableConcept' is not null then
                replace(resource->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display', ',', ' ')
            when resource->'$.valueString' is not null then
                replace(resource->>'$.valueString', ',', ' ')
            else null
        end                                                               as observation_value,
        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then
                resource->>'$.valueQuantity.unit'
            else null
        end                                                               as observation_units,
        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                               as observation_value_type
    from raw
    where json_type(resource->'$.component') is null
       or json_array_length(resource->'$.component') = 0
)

select
    observation_datetime,
    observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
from component_rows

union all

select
    observation_datetime,
    observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
from simple_rows
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Transforms raw FHIR STU3 Encounter resources into the staging contract.
--}}

WITH raw_enc AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')                AS start_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')                  AS end_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')          AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')  AS org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                 AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')      AS type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')   AS type_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')    AS reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM raw_enc
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        CAST(start_str AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(COALESCE(end_str, start_str) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        REPLACE(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        SPLIT_PART(org_ref, '|', 2) AS organization_id,
        TRIM(REPLACE(provider_display, 'Dr.', '')) AS provider_name,
        class_code,
        type_code,
        type_display,
        reason_code,
        reason_display
    FROM extracted
),

provider_join AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        p.id AS provider_id
    FROM normalized n
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }} p
        ON n.provider_name = p.NAME
        AND n.organization_id = p.ORGANIZATION
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP'  THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN type_code IN ('702927004')                     THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN type_code IN ('162673000','410620009','308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS encounter_class,
        type_code AS encounter_code,
        type_display AS encounter_description,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        reason_code AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM provider_join
)

SELECT *
FROM final
```

```sql
WITH
-- raw observations
raw_obs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

-- top‑level observations that have a direct value (not just components)
top_obs AS (
    SELECT
        -- datetime (use effectiveDateTime if present, else issued)
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.issued')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        )                                   AS observation_datetime,
        -- patient and encounter IDs (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS encounter_id,
        -- category code (first element)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_category,
        -- observation code (first coding)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_code,
        -- description – prefer the free‑text, fall back to coding display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                   AS observation_description,
        -- value – numeric, coded, or plain string
        COALESCE(
            CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS VARCHAR),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
        )                                   AS observation_value,
        -- units – only for quantity values
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
                                            AS observation_units,
        -- value type
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw_obs
    WHERE
        -- keep rows that actually have a value at the top level
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
        OR json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL
        OR json_extract(resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL
),

-- component observations – each component becomes its own row
component_obs AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.issued')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        )                                   AS observation_datetime,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                ''
            ),
            'urn:uuid:', ''
        )                                   AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_category,
        -- component code
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')
                                            AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                   AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS VARCHAR),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString')
        )                                   AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
                                            AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CAST(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw_obs
    -- explode the component array (if any)
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')
    ) AS comp(value) ON TRUE
    WHERE comp.value IS NOT NULL
),

-- combine top‑level and component rows
all_obs AS (
    SELECT * FROM top_obs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_obs
),

-- add the observation_date column (date part of the timestamp)
final_obs AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        observation_value,
        observation_units,
        observation_value_type
    FROM all_obs
)

SELECT *
FROM final_obs
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Transforms raw FHIR STU3 Encounter resources into the staging contract.
--}}

WITH raw_enc AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')                AS start_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')                  AS end_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')          AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')  AS org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                 AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')      AS type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')   AS type_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')    AS reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM raw_enc
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        CAST(start_str AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(COALESCE(end_str, start_str) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        REPLACE(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        SPLIT_PART(org_ref, '|', 2) AS organization_id,
        TRIM(REPLACE(provider_display, 'Dr.', '')) AS provider_name,
        class_code,
        type_code,
        type_display,
        reason_code,
        reason_display
    FROM extracted
),

provider_join AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        p.id AS provider_id
    FROM normalized n
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }} p
        ON n.provider_name = p.NAME
        AND n.organization_id = p.ORGANIZATION
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP'  THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN type_code IN ('702927004')                     THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN type_code IN ('162673000','410620009','308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS encounter_class,
        type_code AS encounter_code,
        type_display AS encounter_description,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        reason_code AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM provider_join
)

SELECT *
FROM final
```

- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.

```sql
stg_acq__observations as (

        to_timestamp(date_date || ' ' || date_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as observation_datetime,

        -- date portion of the timestamp
        cast(to_timestamp(date_date || ' ' || date_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as date) as observation_date,

        -- identifiers
        patient   as patient_id,
        encounter as encounter_id,

        -- category
        category as observation_category,

        -- split "code | description" into separate columns
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '') as observation_code,
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 2)), '') as observation_description,

        -- value, units and type
        value as observation_value,
        units as observation_units,
        type  as observation_value_type
    from raw_observations
)

from stg_acq__observations
```

```sql
with src as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        -- timestamps (already UTC in source)
        cast(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') as timestamp)   as procedure_stop_datetime,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        replace(coalesce(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.subject.reference'), ''), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        replace(coalesce(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), ''), 'urn:uuid:', '') as encounter_id,

        -- procedure code and description (first coding entry)
        coalesce(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'), '') as procedure_code,
        coalesce(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'), json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.text')) as procedure_description,

        -- base cost not present in FHIR Procedure – set to null
        cast(null as double) as procedure_base_cost,

        -- reason code/description – may be absent; take first entry if present
        json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].code') as procedure_reason_code,
        json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') as procedure_reason_description
    from src
),

date_cols as (
    select
        procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
        procedure_stop_datetime,
        cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        procedure_code,
        procedure_description,
        procedure_base_cost,
        procedure_reason_code,
        procedure_reason_description
    from extracted
)

select *
from date_cols
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'conditions') }}

parsed AS (

        to_date(src."start", '%d-%b-%Y') AS condition_start_date,

        -- Convert stop date if present, otherwise NULL
        CASE
            WHEN src."stop" IS NOT NULL AND src."stop" <> ''
                THEN to_date(src."stop", '%d-%b-%Y')
        END AS condition_stop_date,

        -- Pass through identifiers unchanged
        src."patient"   AS patient_id,
        src."encounter" AS encounter_id,

        -- Split code_display into code and description, trimming whitespace
        trim(split_part(src."code_display", '|', 1)) AS condition_code,
        trim(split_part(src."code_display", '|', 2)) AS condition_description
    FROM src
)
```

```sql
with patients as (

    select
        -- patient_id
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as patient_id,

        -- dates
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
        cast(nullif(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), '') as date) as death_date,

        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "SB")].value') as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value') as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value') as passport_number,

        -- name components (official use)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]') as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family') as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (maiden use)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family') as maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (us‑core extensions)
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")]'
            '.extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
        ) as race,

        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")]'
            '.extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
        ) as ethnicity,

        -- gender conversion
        case lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city, state, country)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")]'
            '.valueAddress.city') ||
        ', ' ||
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")]'
            '.valueAddress.state') ||
        ', ' ||
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")]'
            '.valueAddress.country') as birthplace,

        -- address fields (first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state,
        null as patient_county,  -- not present in FHIR patient resource
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,

        cast(
            nullif(
                json_extract_string(
                    resource,
                    '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]'
                    '.extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
                ),
                ''
            ) as double
        ) as patient_latitude,

        cast(
            nullif(
                json_extract_string(
                    resource,
                    '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]'
                    '.extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
                ),
                ''
            ) as double
        ) as patient_longitude,

        -- financial fields not present in FHIR – set to null
        null as healthcare_expenses,
        null as healthcare_coverage

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}

)

select *
from patients
```

```sql
with
    source_conditions as (
        select
            -- raw JSON column
            resource
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    ),

    parsed as (
        select
            -- start / stop dates: take the date part of the ISO‑8601 timestamps
            cast(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') as timestamp)::date
                as condition_start_date,

            cast(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') as timestamp)::date
                as condition_stop_date,

            -- patient and encounter identifiers: strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix
            replace(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')
                as patient_id,

            replace(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')
                as encounter_id,

            -- condition code (SNOMED etc.)
            json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
                as condition_code,

            -- description: prefer the display value, fall back to the free‑text element
            coalesce(
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.text')
            ) as condition_description
        from source_conditions
    )

select *
from parsed
```

```sql
with source_observations as (

    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}

),

parsed as (

    select
        -- datetime fields
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as effective_dt,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')               as issued_dt,

        -- references
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')   as subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')   as context_ref,

        -- category & code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')   as category_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')         as code_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')                 as code_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')    as code_display,

        -- possible value representations
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')                         as value_string,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')           as value_codeable_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display') as value_codeable_display,
        json_extract_float(resource,  '$.valueQuantity.value')                as value_quantity,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                  as value_units

    from source_observations
),

final as (

    select
        -- observation timestamp (prefer effectiveDateTime, fallback to issued)
        cast(coalesce(effective_dt, issued_dt) as timestamp)               as observation_datetime,

        -- patient & encounter ids – strip the urn prefix, keep the UUID
        regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:]', '')                         as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(context_ref, '^.*[:]', '')                         as encounter_id,

        -- category & code fields
        category_code                                                     as observation_category,
        code_code                                                         as observation_code,
        coalesce(code_text, code_display)                                 as observation_description,

        -- observation value & units
        case
            when value_quantity is not null then cast(value_quantity as varchar)
            when value_string is not null   then value_string
            when value_codeable_text is not null then value_codeable_text
            when value_codeable_display is not null then value_codeable_display
            else null
        end                                                               as observation_value,

        value_units                                                       as observation_units,

        case
            when value_quantity is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                               as observation_value_type
    from parsed
)

select
    observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date) as observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
from final
```

## Mapping hints
- CODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.
- REASONCODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.

```sql
WITH
raw_encounters AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }}
),

class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),

mapped AS (
    SELECT
        raw_encounters."Id"                               AS encounter_id,
        CAST(raw_encounters."START" AS TIMESTAMP)        AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(raw_encounters."STOP"  AS TIMESTAMP)        AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        raw_encounters."PATIENT"                         AS patient_id,
        raw_encounters."ORGANIZATION"                    AS organization_id,
        raw_encounters."PROVIDER"                        AS provider_id,
        raw_encounters."PAYER"                           AS payer_id,
        class_map.standard_value                         AS encounter_class,
        REPLACE(raw_encounters."CODE", 'SCT:', '')        AS encounter_code,
        raw_encounters."DESCRIPTION"                     AS encounter_description,
        raw_encounters."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST"             AS base_encounter_cost,
        raw_encounters."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST"                AS total_encounter_cost,
        raw_encounters."PAYER_COVERAGE"                  AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        CASE
            WHEN raw_encounters."REASONCODE" IS NOT NULL
                THEN REPLACE(raw_encounters."REASONCODE", 'SCT:', '')
        END                                              AS encounter_reason_code,
        raw_encounters."REASONDESCRIPTION"               AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_encounters
    LEFT JOIN class_map
        ON raw_encounters."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = class_map.local_code
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)                                   AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    COALESCE(CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE),
             CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE))                         AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM mapped
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH
raw_encounter AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        REPLACE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,

        -- organization identifier after the pipe character in the reference
        regexp_extract(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS organization_id,

        -- provider name stripped of leading “Dr.” (the provider id is looked‑up later)
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\\.?\\s+',
            ''
        ) AS provider_name,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                     AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')          AS type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')          AS encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')      AS encounter_description,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')       AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')   AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_encounter
),

provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.Id AS provider_id
    FROM extracted e
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }} p
        ON p.NAME = e.provider_name
       AND p.ORGANIZATION = e.organization_id
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN type_code IN ('702927004') THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN type_code IN ('162673000','410620009','308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM provider_lookup
)

SELECT *
FROM final
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

obs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        REPLACE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS obs_code,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',', ' '
        ) AS obs_description,
        json_array_length(resource->'$.component') AS comp_len
    FROM raw
),

component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        o.observation_datetime,
        o.patient_id,
        o.encounter_id,
        o.observation_category,
        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].code.text'),
                json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',', ' '
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                printf('%.1f',
                    CAST(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE)
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(
                    COALESCE(
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueCodeableConcept.text')
                    ),
                    ',', ' '
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueString'), ',', ' ')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM obs o
    JOIN generate_series(0, o.comp_len - 1) AS g(idx)
),

non_component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        o.observation_datetime,
        o.patient_id,
        o.encounter_id,
        o.observation_category,
        o.obs_code AS observation_code,
        o.obs_description AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                printf('%.1f',
                    CAST(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE)
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(
                    COALESCE(
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
                    ),
                    ',', ' '
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueString'), ',', ' ')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM obs o
    WHERE o.comp_len = 0 OR o.comp_len IS NULL
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM component_rows

UNION ALL

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM non_component_rows
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component['||g.idx||'].valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM obs o
    JOIN generate_series(0, o.comp_len - 1) AS g(idx)
),

non_component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        o.observation_datetime,
        o.patient_id,
        o.encounter_id,
        o.observation_category,
        o.obs_code AS observation_code,
        o.obs_description AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                printf('%.1f',
                    CAST(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE)
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(
                    COALESCE(
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                        json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
                    ),
                    ',', ' '
                )
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueString'), ',', ' ')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                json_extract_string(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            WHEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM obs o
    WHERE o.comp_len = 0 OR o.comp_len IS NULL
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM component_rows
```

- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.

```sql
                '^Dr\\.?\\s+',
```

```sql
        -- encounter code & description (commas replaced by spaces)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')              AS encounter_code,
```

```sql
raw_encounter AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        -- timestamps (keep UTC offset, cast to TIMESTAMP)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- patient reference (strip leading urn:uuid:)
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (after the final pipe character)
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS organization_id,

        -- provider handling – we will not attempt to resolve to a provider_id
        NULL AS provider_id,

        -- encounter class mapping
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') = 'IMP'  THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') IN ('702927004') THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') IN ('162673000','410620009','308646001') THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'outpatient'
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS encounter_class,

        -- encounter code & description (commas replaced by spaces)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_description,

        -- cost columns are not present in the FHIR resource
        CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- payer not present
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,

        -- reason code & description (may be null, commas replaced by spaces)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_encounter
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,

        COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,

        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        payer_id,

        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_encounter_cost,
        encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT *
FROM final
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id AS patient_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS DATE) AS death_date,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="SS")].value') AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="DL")].value') AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="PPN")].value') AS passport_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family') AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="maiden")].family') AS maiden_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url=="ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS race,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url=="ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS ethnicity,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS patient_gender,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.city') AS birthplace,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state_abbr,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="latitude")].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="longitude")].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_longitude,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM src
)
```

```sql
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        id AS patient_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,

        -- birth and death dates
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE)                               AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NOT NULL
                THEN SPLIT_PART(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS DATE
        )                                                                                     AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
               AND JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')                    AS ssn,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')                        AS drivers_license_number,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')                       AS passport_number,

        -- name components (official name)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')                                   AS patient_prefix,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                                    AS patient_first_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].family')                                      AS patient_last_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')                                   AS patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (use = maiden)
        (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.family')
         FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.name')) AS n
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.use') = 'maiden'
         LIMIT 1)                                                                              AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status code
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                       AS marital_status,

        -- race and ethnicity (text value is second element of the inner extension array)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString')             AS race,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString')             AS ethnicity,

        -- gender to single‑letter code
        CASE LOWER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))
        END                                                                                  AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace concatenated as "city  state  country"
        CONCAT_WS('  ',
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                                     AS birthplace,

        -- address fields (use first address entry)
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.address[0].line'), ', ')                    AS patient_address,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.address[0].city')                                    AS patient_city,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.address[0].state')                                   AS patient_state_abbr,
        NULL                                                                                  AS patient_county,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                             AS patient_zip,

        -- latitude / longitude (geolocation extension inside first address)
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[0].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[1].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_longitude,

        -- healthcare expense / coverage – not present in FHIR, return NULL
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                           AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                           AS healthcare_coverage

    FROM raw
),

with_state AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        s.state_name AS patient_state
    FROM extracted e
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} s
        ON e.patient_state_abbr = s.state_abbreviation
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
FROM with_state
```
