```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source_patients AS (
    SELECT
        -- Basic identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')                                   AS patient_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE)              AS birth_date,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS DATE)   AS death_date,

        -- Identifiers (assumes ordering as in example)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value')                  AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value')                  AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[4].value')                  AS passport_number,

        -- Name fields (official name assumed first entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')                     AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                     AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family')                       AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')                     AS patient_suffix,

        -- Maiden name (maiden use, may be missing → NULL)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use==\"maiden\")].family')    AS maiden_name,

        -- Demographics
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')         AS marital_status,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString') AS race,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString') AS ethnicity,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END                                                                       AS patient_gender,

        -- Birthplace (extension[4] per observed ordering)
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                          AS birthplace,

        -- Address (first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')                     AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city')                       AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state')                      AS patient_state,
        NULL                                                                       AS patient_county,   -- not supplied in FHIR patient
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                AS patient_zip,

        -- Geolocation (first extension of first address, latitude then longitude)
        CAST(json_extract_double(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[0].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(json_extract_double(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[1].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_longitude,

        -- Financial fields not present in FHIR patient → NULL
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                               AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                               AS healthcare_coverage

    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
)

SELECT *
FROM source_patients
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
with
raw as (
    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        patient_id,

        -- dates
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
                then cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 1, 10) as date)
            else null
        end as death_date,

        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[1].value') as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value') as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value') as passport_number,

        -- name components
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]') as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family') as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[1].family') as maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status,

        -- race mapping
        lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString')) as _race_raw,

        -- ethnicity mapping
        lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString')) as _ethnicity_raw,

        -- gender mapping
        lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) as _gender_raw,

        -- birthplace concatenation
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city') as _birth_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state') as _birth_state,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country') as _birth_country,

        -- address fields
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state_abbr,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[0].valueDecimal') as double) as patient_latitude,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[1].valueDecimal') as double) as patient_longitude

    from raw
),

mapped as (
    select
        patient_id,
        birth_date,
        death_date,
        ssn,
        drivers_license_number,
        passport_number,
        patient_prefix,
        patient_first_name,
        patient_last_name,
        patient_suffix,
        maiden_name,
        marital_status,
        case
            when _race_raw like '%white%' then 'white'
            when _race_raw like '%black%' or _race_raw like '%african%' then 'black'
            when _race_raw like '%asian%' then 'asian'
            when _race_raw like '%american indian%' or _race_raw like '%alaska native%' then 'native'
            when _race_raw like '%hawaiian%' or _race_raw like '%pacific islander%' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end as race,
        case
            when _ethnicity_raw like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end as ethnicity,
        case _gender_raw
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as patient_gender,
        trim(_birth_city) || '  ' || trim(_birth_state) || '  ' || trim(_birth_country) as birthplace,
        patient_address,
        patient_city,
        st.state_name as patient_state,
        null as patient_county,
        patient_zip,
        patient_latitude,
        patient_longitude,
        null as healthcare_expenses,
        null as healthcare_coverage
    from extracted
    left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} st
        on extracted.patient_state_abbr = st.state_abbreviation
)

select *
from mapped
```

```sql
with raw as (
    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        patient_id,

        -- dates
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate')::date               as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
            then json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')::timestamp::date
        end                                                            as death_date,

        -- identifiers (order in Synthea sample is MR, SS, DL, PPN)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[1].value')          as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value')          as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value')          as passport_number,

        -- name fields (official use)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')            as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')             as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family')               as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')            as patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (use = "maiden" if present)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="maiden")].family') as maiden_name,

        -- marital status code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity – not guaranteed to be present, set to null if not found
        null                                                            as race,
        null                                                            as ethnicity,

        -- gender mapping to single‑letter code
        case json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end                                                            as patient_gender,

        -- birthplace – city component from the birthPlace extension
        json_extract_string(resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.city') 
                                                                        as birthplace,

        -- address fields (take first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')          as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city')             as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state')            as raw_state,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].county')           as patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')       as patient_zip,

        -- latitude / longitude from geolocation extension
        json_extract_string(resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="latitude")].valueDecimal')
            ::float                                                    as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_string(resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="longitude")].valueDecimal')
            ::float                                                    as patient_longitude,

        -- financial columns are not present in the FHIR sample
        null::float                                                    as healthcare_expenses,
        null::float                                                    as healthcare_coverage
    from raw
),

state_normalized as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(st.state_name, raw_state) as patient_state
    from extracted
    left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} st
        on st.state_abbreviation = raw_state
)

select
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
from state_normalized
```

```sql
{{-
-- stg_acq__encounters
-- Transform raw FHIR Encounter resources into the staging contract
-}}
with raw as (

    select
        -- basic identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as encounter_id,

        -- timestamps
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as period_start,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as period_end,

        -- references
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')          as patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') as provider_ref,

        -- classification and type
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                as encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')    as encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_description,

        -- reason
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')    as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_desc

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

transformed as (

    select
        encounter_id,

        -- convert to TIMESTAMP (DuckDB parses ISO‑8601 with offset to UTC)
        cast(period_start as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates derived from timestamps
        cast(period_start as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix)
        regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (extract part after the pipe, if present)
        case
            when org_ref is null then null
            when position('|' in org_ref) > 0 then split_part(org_ref, '|', 2)
            else null
        end as organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract part after the pipe, if present)
        case
            when provider_ref is null then null
            when position('|' in provider_ref) > 0 then split_part(provider_ref, '|', 2)
            else null
        end as provider_id,

        -- payer is not present in the FHIR resource
        null::varchar as payer_id,

        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,

        -- cost fields are not supplied in the source
        null::double as base_encounter_cost,
        null::double as total_encounter_cost,
        null::double as encounter_payer_coverage,

        reason_code as encounter_reason_code,
        reason_desc as encounter_reason_description

    from raw
)

select *
from transformed
```

```sql
with src as (
    select
        -- primary identifier
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as encounter_id,

        -- timestamps (FHIR periods are ISO8601 with UTC offset)
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') as timestamp)   as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- patient reference: "urn:uuid:<id>"
        regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization (serviceProvider) reference: "...|<org_id>"
        regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '^.*\\|', '') as organization_id,

        -- provider and payer not supplied in the FHIR Encounter resource
        null::varchar as provider_id,
        null::varchar as payer_id,

        -- map FHIR class codes to the textual classes used by the acquirer
        case json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')
            when 'AMB'  then 'ambulatory'
            when 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when 'HOME' then 'home'
            when 'DAY'  then 'daytime'
            else json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')
        end as encounter_class,

        -- encounter type code / description (first coding entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as encounter_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) as encounter_description,

        -- cost fields are not present in the source
        null::double as base_encounter_cost,
        null::double as total_encounter_cost,
        null::double as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')    as encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_reason_description

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

select
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    cast(encounter_start_datetime as date)                                   as encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    coalesce(cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date),
             cast(encounter_start_datetime as date))                        as encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
from src
```

```sql
stg_acq__encounters
Transforms raw FHIR Encounter resources into the standard staging contract.

WITH source_enc AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        -- timestamps (naive UTC)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates derived from timestamps
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS encounter_stop_date,

        -- foreign keys
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '.*\\|',
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '.*\\|',
            ''
        ) AS provider_id,

        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

        -- encounter attributes
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
with source_patients as (

    select
        id as patient_id,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as birth_date_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as deceased_dt,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "SS")].value') as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value') as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value') as passport_number,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]') as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family') as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family') as maiden_name,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender') as gender_raw,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display') as race_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display') as ethnicity_display,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.city') as birth_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.state') as birth_state,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.country') as birth_country,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state_abbr,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,

        json_extract_double(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal') as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_double(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal') as patient_longitude

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4','patient') }}

),

transformed as (

    select
        patient_id,

        cast(birth_date_str as date) as birth_date,

        case
            when deceased_dt is not null then cast(substr(deceased_dt,1,10) as date)
            else null
        end as death_date,

        ssn,
        drivers_license_number,
        passport_number,

        patient_prefix,
        patient_first_name,
        patient_last_name,
        patient_suffix,
        maiden_name,

        marital_status_raw as marital_status,

        case lower(race_display)
            when 'white' then 'white'
            when 'black or african american' then 'black'
            when 'asian' then 'asian'
            when 'american indian or alaska native' then 'native'
            when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end as race,

        case
            when lower(ethnicity_display) like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end as ethnicity,

        case
            when gender_raw = 'male' then 'M'
            when gender_raw = 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as patient_gender,

        concat_ws('  ', birth_city, birth_state, birth_country) as birthplace,

        patient_address,
        patient_city,
        map.state_name as patient_state,
        null as patient_county,
        patient_zip,
        patient_latitude,
        patient_longitude,
        null as healthcare_expenses,
        null as healthcare_coverage

    from source_patients
    left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as map
        on map.state_abbreviation = source_patients.patient_state_abbr
)

select *
from transformed
```

```sql
{{-
    -- stg_acq__conditions
    -- Transform raw FHIR Condition resources into the staging contract
-}}
with
raw_conditions as (
    select
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        -- start date: onsetDateTime (date part only, cast to DATE)
        cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'), 1, 10) as date) as condition_start_date,

        -- stop date: abatementDateTime if present, otherwise NULL
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') is not null
            then cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime'), 1, 10) as date)
        end as condition_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (strip leading "urn:uuid:")
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        -- encounter identifier (strip leading "urn:uuid:")
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,

        -- condition code (first coding entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as condition_code,

        -- condition description: prefer coding display, fall back to code.text
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as condition_description
    from raw_conditions
)

select *
from extracted
```

```sql
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS organization_id,

        -- provider reference: first participant's individual reference "...|<prov_id>"
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,

        -- primary encounter type code and description
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_description,

        -- reason (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)                                   AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(raw_encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime)          AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    CAST(COALESCE(raw_encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR                                                            AS payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT                                                              AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT                                                              AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT                                                              AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM cte
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Maps raw FHIR R4 Encounter resources into the acquirer’s staging contract.
--}}

with

raw_enc as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

-- extract primitive fields from the JSON payload
extracted as (
    select
        encounter_id,

        -- patient reference without the urn:uuid: prefix
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        -- period start / end timestamps (ISO8601 with offset)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')          as start_iso,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')            as end_iso,

        -- class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')           as class_code,

        -- encounter type coding (first element)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        -- reason code / description (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display,

        -- service provider reference (contains org id after a '|')
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as service_provider_ref,

        -- primary participant display (contains provider name prefixed with "Dr. ")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as participant_display
    from raw_enc
),

-- resolve organization_id and provider_id
joined as (
    select
        e.*,

        -- organization_id: text after the final pipe character
        regexp_extract(e.service_provider_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$', 1) as organization_id,

        -- provider name without leading "Dr. " (trim whitespace)
        trim(regexp_replace(e.participant_display, '^Dr\\.\\s*', '')) as provider_name
    from extracted e
),

-- lookup provider_id using name + organization match
provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as organization_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

-- bring everything together and compute derived columns
final as (
    select
        j.encounter_id,

        -- timestamps converted to UTC (DuckDB to_timestamp handles the offset)
        to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_start_datetime,
        to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates (date part of timestamps)
        cast(to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        j.patient_id,
        j.organization_id,

        -- provider_id via name + organization join; if not found, return NULL
        prov.provider_id,

        -- payer information not present in FHIR; set NULL
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,

        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when j.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when j.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when j.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when j.type_code in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when j.type_code in ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,

        -- code & description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.type_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.type_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        -- cost columns – not available, return NULL
        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description

    from joined j
    left join provider_lookup prov
        on lower(j.provider_name) = prov.provider_name_lc
        and j.organization_id = prov.organization_id
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
        -- organization id is the part after the pipe in serviceProvider.reference
        regexp_extract(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '\\|(.*)$', 1) as organization_id,
        -- raw class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code_raw,
        -- first type coding code and display (used for class mapping, code & description)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') as type_code_raw,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) as encounter_description_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') as encounter_code_raw,
        -- reason (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') as encounter_reason_code_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_reason_description_raw,
        -- participant display (e.g., "Dr. John Doe") – strip leading “Dr.” and trim
        trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\\.\\s*',
            ''
        )) as provider_display_clean
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as org_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

joined as (
    select
        e.*,
        pl.provider_id
    from raw_enc e
    left join provider_lookup pl
        on pl.provider_name_lc = lower(e.provider_display_clean)
        and pl.org_id = e.organization_id
),

final as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date) as encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        null as payer_id,
        case
            when class_code_raw = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when class_code_raw = 'IMP' then 'inpatient'
            when class_code_raw = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when type_code_raw in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when type_code_raw in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,
        encounter_code_raw as encounter_code,
        encounter_description_raw as encounter_description,
        null::float as base_encounter_cost,
        null::float as total_encounter_cost,
        null::float as encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code_raw as encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description_raw as encounter_reason_description
    from joined
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- Timestamps (converted to naive TIMESTAMP)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')   AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,

        -- Patient and encounter IDs (strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix)
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), ':', 3)   AS patient_id,
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), ':', 3) AS encounter_id,

        -- Procedure code & description
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                                            AS procedure_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        )                                                                                               AS procedure_description,

        -- Fields not present in the FHIR Procedure resource
        NULL::DOUBLE   AS procedure_base_cost,
        NULL::VARCHAR  AS procedure_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display')                                   AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE)   AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH
    proc_raw AS (
        SELECT
            id,
            resource
        FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
    ),

    proc_parsed AS (
        SELECT
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')   AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
            REPLACE(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.subject.reference'),   'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
            REPLACE(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
            json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                         AS procedure_code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.text')
            )                                                                           AS procedure_description,
            json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference')               AS reason_ref_raw
        FROM proc_raw
    ),

    reason_prep AS (
        SELECT
            *,
            REPLACE(reason_ref_raw, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS reason_condition_id
        FROM proc_parsed
    ),

    cond_raw AS (
        SELECT
            id,
            resource
        FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    ),

    cond_parsed AS (
        SELECT
            id,
            json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                         AS condition_code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.text')
            )                                                                           AS condition_display
        FROM cond_raw
    ),

    final AS (
        SELECT
            r.procedure_start_datetime,
            CAST(r.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
            r.procedure_stop_datetime,
            CAST(r.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE)   AS procedure_stop_date,
            r.patient_id,
            r.encounter_id,
            r.procedure_code,
            r.procedure_description,
            NULL::DOUBLE                               AS procedure_base_cost,
            c.condition_code                           AS procedure_reason_code,
            c.condition_display                        AS procedure_reason_description
        FROM reason_prep r
        LEFT JOIN cond_parsed c
            ON r.reason_condition_id = c.id
    )

SELECT *
FROM final
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
with
raw_procedures as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

raw_conditions as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

parsed_conditions as (
    select
        id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as reason_description
    from raw_conditions
),

parsed_procedures as (
    select
        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,

        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,

        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as procedure_code,

        replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as procedure_description,

        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from raw_procedures
),

joined as (
    select
        p.procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(p.procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
        p.procedure_stop_datetime,
        cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
        p.patient_id,
        p.encounter_id,
        p.procedure_code,
        p.procedure_description,
        null::float as procedure_base_cost,
        c.reason_code as procedure_reason_code,
        c.reason_description as procedure_reason_description
    from parsed_procedures p
    left join parsed_conditions c
        on c.id = p.reason_condition_id
)

select *
from joined
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.

```sql
WITH procedures_raw AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') AS start_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS end_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS proc_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS proc_desc,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

condition_codes AS (
    SELECT
        id AS condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS reason_desc
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

proc_clean AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(start_str AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(end_str AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
        proc_code AS procedure_code,
        proc_desc AS procedure_description,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS procedure_base_cost,
        regexp_replace(reason_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') AS reason_condition_id
    FROM procedures_raw
)

SELECT
    pc.procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(pc.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    pc.procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(pc.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    pc.patient_id,
    pc.encounter_id,
    pc.procedure_code,
    pc.procedure_description,
    pc.procedure_base_cost,
    rc.reason_code AS procedure_reason_code,
    rc.reason_desc AS procedure_reason_description
FROM proc_clean pc
LEFT JOIN condition_codes rc
    ON rc.condition_id = pc.reason_condition_id
```

```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- datetime (use effectiveDateTime, fall back to issued)
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued') AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS observation_datetime,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip leading "urn:uuid:")
        TRIM(LEADING 'urn:uuid:' FROM COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '')) AS patient_id,
        TRIM(LEADING 'urn:uuid:' FROM COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), '')) AS encounter_id,

        -- category code (first entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,

        -- observation code (first coding)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,

        -- description: prefer code.text, else first coding display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) AS observation_description,

        -- value handling (numeric vs text)
        CASE
            WHEN json_typeof(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN json_typeof(json_extract(resource, '$.valueString')) = 'STRING' THEN
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
            WHEN json_typeof(json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,

        -- units (only for Quantity)
        CASE
            WHEN json_typeof(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_units,

        -- value type indicator
        CASE
            WHEN json_typeof(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM parsed
WHERE observation_datetime IS NOT NULL
```

```sql
WITH observations_raw AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource,
        -- datetime (effectiveDateTime preferred, fall back to issued)
        COALESCE(
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.issued')
        ) AS obs_dt_str,
        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
        -- category code (first entry)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        -- observation code (first coding entry)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        -- description: prefer code.text, otherwise the display of the first coding
        COALESCE(
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.code.text'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) AS observation_description,
        -- value extraction
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')      AS value_quantity,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')       AS value_units,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text') AS value_codeable_text,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.valueString')              AS value_string,
        -- fallback unit from CodeableConcept coding display (if needed)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display') AS cc_unit_display
    FROM observations_raw
)

SELECT
    CAST(obs_dt_str AS TIMESTAMP)                                           AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(CAST(obs_dt_str AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)                             AS observation_date,
    patient_id                                                              AS patient_id,
    encounter_id                                                            AS encounter_id,
    observation_category                                                    AS observation_category,
    observation_code                                                        AS observation_code,
    observation_description                                                 AS observation_description,
    COALESCE(value_quantity, value_codeable_text, value_string)            AS observation_value,
    COALESCE(value_units, cc_unit_display)                                  AS observation_units,
    CASE
        WHEN value_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
        ELSE 'text'
    END                                                                     AS observation_value_type
FROM parsed
```

```sql
{{-
/*  stg_acq__observations
    Transform raw FHIR Observation resources into the staging contract.
    One row per observation (or per component when present).
-}}
-}}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')            AS effectiveDateTime,
        json_extract(resource, '$.issued')                      AS issued,
        json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference')          AS subject_ref,
        json_extract(resource, '$.encounter.reference')        AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')  AS category_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')         AS code_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.text')                  AS code_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')     AS code_display,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')        AS value_quantity,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')         AS value_units,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueString')                AS value_string,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text') AS value_codeable_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')                  AS component_json
    FROM src
),

main_rows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        effectiveDateTime,
        issued,
        subject_ref,
        encounter_ref,
        category_code,
        code_code                                            AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(code_text, code_display)                    AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(
            value_quantity::VARCHAR,
            value_string,
            value_codeable_text
        )                                                    AS observation_value,
        value_units                                          AS observation_units,
        CASE WHEN value_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric' ELSE 'text' END AS observation_value_type
    FROM base
    WHERE component_json IS NULL OR json_array_length(component_json) = 0
),

component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        b.id,
        b.effectiveDateTime,
        b.issued,
        b.subject_ref,
        b.encounter_ref,
        b.category_code,
        json_extract(c.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')        AS observation_code,
        json_extract(c.value, '$.code.text')                AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                THEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')::VARCHAR
            WHEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL
                THEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueString')
            WHEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text') IS NOT NULL
                THEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                  AS observation_value,
        json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')       AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                  AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b,
    LATERAL json_each(b.component_json) AS c
)

SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(effectiveDateTime, issued) AS TIMESTAMP)          AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(COALESCE(effectiveDateTime, issued) AS DATE)              AS observation_date,
    regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                  AS patient_id,
    regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                AS encounter_id,
    category_code                                                   AS observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM main_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_rows
) AS combined
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__observations

WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource::json AS res
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

-- Observations that have no component array (or empty)
obs_no_component AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(res, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(res, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(res, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueString')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) = 0
),

-- Observations that contain a component array – one row per component
obs_with_component AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(res, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(res -> 'component') AS comp(value) ON TRUE
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) > 0
),

all_obs AS (
    SELECT * FROM obs_no_component
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM obs_with_component
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    REPLACE(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
    REPLACE(encounter_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM all_obs
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
with
src as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

-- observations that have components → one row per component
comp_rows as (
    select
        (resource->'$.effectiveDateTime')::timestamp            as observation_datetime,
        (resource->'$.subject.reference')                       as subject_ref,
        (resource->'$.encounter.reference')                     as encounter_ref,
        (resource->'$.category[0].coding[0].code')               as observation_category,
        (c->'$.code.coding[0].code')                            as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            (c->'$.code.coding[0].display'),
            (c->'$.code.text')
        )                                                       as observation_description,

        -- raw value (numeric or text)
        case
            when c->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then (c->'$.valueQuantity.value')
            when c->'$.valueCodeableConcept' is not null then (c->'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            when c->'$.valueString' is not null then (c->'$.valueString')
        end                                                   as raw_value,

        -- units (only for quantity)
        case
            when c->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then (c->'$.valueQuantity.unit')
        end                                                   as observation_units,

        case
            when c->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                   as observation_value_type
    from src,
    lateral json_array_elements(resource->'$.component') as c
),

-- observations without components → single row per observation
noncomp_rows as (
    select
        (resource->'$.effectiveDateTime')::timestamp            as observation_datetime,
        (resource->'$.subject.reference')                       as subject_ref,
        (resource->'$.encounter.reference')                     as encounter_ref,
        (resource->'$.category[0].coding[0].code')               as observation_category,
        (resource->'$.code.coding[0].code')                     as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            (resource->'$.code.coding[0].display'),
            (resource->'$.code.text')
        )                                                       as observation_description,

        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then (resource->'$.valueQuantity.value')
            when resource->'$.valueCodeableConcept' is not null then (resource->'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            when resource->'$.valueString' is not null then (resource->'$.valueString')
        end                                                   as raw_value,

        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then (resource->'$.valueQuantity.unit')
        end                                                   as observation_units,

        case
            when resource->'$.valueQuantity' is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                   as observation_value_type
    from src
    where (resource->'$.component') is null
       or json_array_length(resource->'$.component') = 0
)

select
    observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date)                         as observation_date,
    replace(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                      as patient_id,
    replace(encounter_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                    as encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    case
        when observation_value_type = 'numeric' then sprintf('%.1f', cast(raw_value as double))
        else replace(cast(raw_value as varchar), ',', ' ')
    end                                                         as observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
from (
    select * from comp_rows
    union all
    select * from noncomp_rows
) t
where observation_datetime is not null
```

```sql
{{--
    Model: stg_acq__allergies
    Purpose: Transform raw FHIR R4 AllergyIntolerance resources into the
             staging contract expected by downstream models.
--}}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

mapped AS (
    SELECT
        -- start/stop dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMP)::DATE
            AS allergy_start_date,
        NULL::DATE AS allergy_stop_date,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,

        -- allergy code information
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')           AS allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')         AS allergy_code_system,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                                               AS allergy_description,

        -- type / category
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type')                         AS allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]')                  AS allergy_category,

        -- first reaction (if any)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')
                                                                    AS reaction_1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
                                                                    AS reaction_1_description,
        UPPER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity'))
                                                                    AS reaction_1_severity,

        -- second reaction (if any)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')
                                                                    AS reaction_2_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
                                                                    AS reaction_2_description,
        UPPER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity'))
                                                                    AS reaction_2_severity
    FROM src
)

SELECT *
FROM mapped
```

```sql
with source_allergy as (
    select
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
)

select
    cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') as date)                               as allergy_start_date,
    null::date                                                                                as allergy_stop_date,
    split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), ':', 3)                  as patient_id,
    null::varchar                                                                             as encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                                   as allergy_code,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')                                 as allergy_code_system,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
    )                                                                                         as allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.type')                                                  as allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]')                                           as allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')           as reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )                                                                                         as reaction_1_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity'))                           as reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')           as reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )                                                                                         as reaction_2_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity'))                           as reaction_2_severity
from source_allergy
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP)                           AS observation_datetime,
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')                 AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '')               AS encounter_id,
        json_extract(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')                                   AS observation_category,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                                         AS main_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.text')                                                  AS main_description,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')                                        AS main_value_quantity,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                                         AS main_units,
        json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity'))                                    AS value_quantity_type,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')                     AS main_value_codeable_display,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueString')                                                AS main_value_string,
        json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept'))                            AS value_codeable_type,
        resource                                                                                AS full_resource
    FROM source
),

component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        b.observation_datetime,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        json_extract(comp, '$.code.coding[0].code')                                            AS observation_code,
        json_extract(comp, '$.code.text')                                                     AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                printf('%.1f', CAST(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            ELSE
                json_extract(comp, '$.valueString')
        END                                                                                 AS observation_value_raw,
        json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                                            AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT json_extract(b.full_resource, '$.component[' || i || ']') AS comp
        FROM range(0, json_array_length(json_extract(b.full_resource, '$.component')) - 1) AS t(i)
    ) AS c ON TRUE
),

simple_rows AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        main_code                                 AS observation_code,
        main_description                          AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN
                printf('%.1f', CAST(main_value_quantity AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN value_codeable_type = 'OBJECT' THEN main_value_codeable_display
            ELSE main_value_string
        END                                      AS observation_value_raw,
        main_units                                AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                      AS observation_value_type
    FROM base
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(full_resource, '$.component')) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(json_extract(full_resource, '$.component')) = 0
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE)               AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    REPLACE(observation_description, ',', ' ')       AS observation_description,
    REPLACE(observation_value_raw, ',', ' ')         AS observation_value,
    REPLACE(observation_units, ',', ' ')             AS observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM component_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM simple_rows
) AS final
```
