## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
with
-- extract needed fields from AllergyIntolerance resources
allergies as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') as recorded_dt,
        substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate'), 1, 10) as start_date,
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as allergy_desc_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') as allergy_desc_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as allergy_system_url,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction1_desc_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') as reaction1_severity_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction2_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction2_desc_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') as reaction2_severity_raw
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

-- extract encounter start timestamps to allow linking
encounters as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as period_start
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

select
    cast(start_date as date)                              as allergy_start_date,
    cast(null as date)                                    as allergy_stop_date,
    patient_id                                            as patient_id,
    e.encounter_id                                        as encounter_id,
    allergy_code                                          as allergy_code,
    case
        when allergy_system_url like '%snomed%' then 'SNOMED-CT'
        when allergy_system_url like '%rxnorm%' then 'RxNorm'
        else allergy_system_url
    end                                                   as allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        coalesce(allergy_desc_raw, allergy_desc_text),
        ',', ' '
    )                                                     as allergy_description,
    allergy_type                                          as allergy_type,
    allergy_category                                      as allergy_category,
    reaction1_code                                        as reaction_1_code,
    replace(reaction1_desc_raw, ',', ' ')                 as reaction_1_description,
    upper(reaction1_severity_raw)                         as reaction_1_severity,
    reaction2_code                                        as reaction_2_code,
    replace(reaction2_desc_raw, ',', ' ')                 as reaction_2_description,
    upper(reaction2_severity_raw)                         as reaction_2_severity
from allergies a
left join encounters e
    on a.recorded_dt = e.period_start
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
with
-- Extract fields from the AllergyIntolerance resources
allergy as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') as recorded_date,
        substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate'), 1, 10) as start_date,
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as allergy_code_system_url,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as allergy_description,
        -- reaction 1 (index 0)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction0_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction0_desc,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') as reaction0_severity,
        -- reaction 2 (index 1)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction1_desc,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') as reaction1_severity
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

-- Extract encounter IDs and their start timestamps
encounter as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as period_start
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

-- Join allergies to the encounter whose period.start matches the allergy's recordedDate
joined as (
    select
        a.start_date as allergy_start_date,
        cast(null as date) as allergy_stop_date,
        a.patient_id,
        e.encounter_id,
        a.allergy_code,
        case
            when a.allergy_code_system_url ilike '%snomed%' then 'SNOMED-CT'
            when a.allergy_code_system_url ilike '%rxnorm%' then 'RxNorm'
            else a.allergy_code_system_url
        end as allergy_code_system,
        a.allergy_description as allergy_description,
        a.allergy_type as allergy_type,
        a.allergy_category as allergy_category,
        replace(a.reaction0_code, ',', ' ') as reaction_1_code,
        replace(a.reaction0_desc, ',', ' ') as reaction_1_description,
        upper(a.reaction0_severity) as reaction_1_severity,
        replace(a.reaction1_code, ',', ' ') as reaction_2_code,
        replace(a.reaction1_desc, ',', ' ') as reaction_2_description,
        upper(a.reaction1_severity) as reaction_2_severity
    from allergy a
    left join encounter e
        on e.period_start = a.recorded_date
)

select
    allergy_start_date::date as allergy_start_date,
    allergy_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    allergy_code,
    allergy_code_system,
    allergy_description,
    allergy_type,
    allergy_category,
    reaction_1_code,
    reaction_1_description,
    reaction_1_severity,
    reaction_2_code,
    reaction_2_description,
    reaction_2_severity
from joined
```

```sql
with source as (
    select
        id as fhir_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        -- dates
        try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') as timestamp)::date as allergy_start_date,
        null::date as allergy_stop_date,

        -- identifiers
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') is not null then
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                    '^urn:uuid:',
                    ''
                )
            else null
        end as encounter_id,

        -- allergy code details
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') ilike '%snomed%' then 'SNOMED-CT'
            else json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        end as allergy_code_system,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) as allergy_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,

        -- first reaction (if any)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_1_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') as reaction_1_severity,

        -- second reaction (if any)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_2_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_2_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') as reaction_2_severity
    from source
)

select
    allergy_start_date,
    allergy_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    allergy_code,
    allergy_code_system,
    allergy_description,
    allergy_type,
    allergy_category,
    reaction_1_code,
    reaction_1_description,
    reaction_1_severity,
    reaction_2_code,
    reaction_2_description,
    reaction_2_severity
from extracted
```

```sql
with raw_patients as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as birth_date_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as death_date_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[1].value') as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value') as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value') as passport_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]') as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family') as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
        -- maiden name may be stored as a separate name entry with use = "maiden"
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="maiden")].family[0]') as maiden_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status,
        -- race: use the human‑readable text value inside the US‑Core race extension
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race\")].extension[?(@.url==\"text\")].valueString'
        ) as race,
        -- ethnicity: similar to race
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity\")].extension[?(@.url==\"text\")].valueString'
        ) as ethnicity,
        -- map gender to the single‑letter code used in the contract
        case
            when lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' then 'M'
            when lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' then 'F'
            else upper(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
        end as patient_gender,
        -- birthplace: city + state + country from the birthPlace extension
        concat_ws(
            ' ',
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.city'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.state'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.country'
            )
        ) as birthplace,
        -- address fields (first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state,
        null as patient_county,  -- not present in FHIR Patient
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,
        -- latitude / longitude from geolocation extension on the address
        json_extract_double(
            resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation\")].extension[?(@.url==\"latitude\")].valueDecimal'
        ) as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_double(
            resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation\")].extension[?(@.url==\"longitude\")].valueDecimal'
        ) as patient_longitude,
        -- healthcare expenses / coverage are not part of the standard FHIR Patient;
        -- they are not available in the source data, so we return NULLs.
        null::float as healthcare_expenses,
        null::float as healthcare_coverage,
        -- cast dates
        cast(birth_date_raw as date) as birth_date,
        case
            when death_date_raw is null then null
            else cast(split_part(death_date_raw, 'T', 1) as date)
        end as death_date
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
)

select
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
from raw_patients
```

```sql
{{-
/*
stg_acq__patients
Transform raw FHIR STU3 Patient resources into the staging contract.
*/
-}}

WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- patient identifier
        id AS patient_id,

        -- dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            NULLIF(
                SPLIT_PART(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1),
                ''
            )
            AS DATE
        ) AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "SB")].value'
        ) AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value'
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value'
        ) AS passport_number,

        -- name parts
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]'
        ) AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]'
        ) AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family'
        ) AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]'
        ) AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family'
        ) AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code'
        ) AS marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (use the human‑readable text if present)
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
            )
        ) AS race,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
            )
        ) AS ethnicity,

        -- gender converted to the single‑letter code used by the synthea model
        CASE LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city state country concatenated)
        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country'
            )
        ) AS birthplace,

        -- address components (use first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,

        -- geolocation
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_longitude,

        -- financial columns – not present in the FHIR payload
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM source
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__patients
--}}
WITH
raw AS (
    SELECT
        id AS patient_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,

        -- dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE)                                   AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE
        )                                                                                           AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="SB")].value'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="DL")].value'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="PPN")].value'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS passport_number,

        -- name (official)
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].prefix'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].given'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].family'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].suffix'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (from extension)
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-mothersMaidenName")].valueString[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code'
            ),
            '$'
        )                                                                                           AS marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (us‑core extensions)
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS race,
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'
            ),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS ethnicity,

        -- gender mapping to M/F
        CASE LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END                                                                                         AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city state country)
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            json_extract_string(resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city[0]'
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state[0]'
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country[0]'
            )
        )                                                                                           AS birthplace,

        -- address fields (first line, city, state, zip)
        json_extract_string(
            json_extract(resource, '$.address[0].line'),
            '$[0]'
        )                                                                                           AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city')                                         AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state')                                        AS patient_state_full,
        NULL                                                                                       AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                                   AS patient_zip,

        -- geolocation
        CAST(
            json_extract(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="latitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        )                                                                                           AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(
            json_extract(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="longitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        )                                                                                           AS patient_longitude,

        -- placeholders for fields not in FHIR
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                                AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                                AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM raw
)

SELECT
    e.patient_id,
    e.birth_date,
    e.death_date,
    e.ssn,
    e.drivers_license_number,
    e.passport_number,
    e.patient_prefix,
    e.patient_first_name,
    e.patient_last_name,
    e.patient_suffix,
    e.maiden_name,
    e.marital_status,
    e.race,
    e.ethnicity,
    e.patient_gender,
    e.birthplace,
    e.patient_address,
    e.patient_city,
    COALESCE(state_map.state_abbreviation, e.patient_state_full)                               AS patient_state,
    e.patient_county,
    e.patient_zip,
    e.patient_latitude,
    e.patient_longitude,
    e.healthcare_expenses,
    e.healthcare_coverage
FROM extracted AS e
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS state_map
  ON LOWER(state_map.state_name) = LOWER(e.patient_state_full);
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Transforms raw FHIR STU3 Encounter resources into the staging contract.
--}}

WITH raw_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP)               AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP)               AS raw_end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')                           AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')                    AS org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                                   AS encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')                        AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        )                                                                               AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference')          AS provider_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')                     AS reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')                  AS reason_description
    FROM raw_encounters
),

cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(raw_end_datetime, encounter_start_datetime)                           AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                                 AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN org_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN org_ref LIKE '%|%' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(org_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$')
            ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(org_ref, '([^/]+)$')
        END                                                                            AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN provider_ref LIKE '%|%' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(provider_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$')
            ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(provider_ref, '([^/]+)$')
        END                                                                            AS provider_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR                                                                   AS payer_id,
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                    AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                    AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                    AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        reason_code                                                                     AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason_description                                                              AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM parsed
),

with_dates AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)                                          AS encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)                                           AS encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_encounter_cost,
        encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM cleaned
)

SELECT *
FROM with_dates
```

```sql
WITH raw_enc AS (
    SELECT
        -- Primary identifier
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,

        -- Datetime fields (keep as naive timestamps)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- References that need UUID extraction
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')            AS patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')    AS organization_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_ref,

        -- Class mapping from FHIR codes to the synthea textual conventions
        CASE json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')
            WHEN 'AMB'   THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN 'EMER'  THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN 'IMP'   THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN 'INPAT' THEN 'inpatient'
            ELSE json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')
        END AS encounter_class,

        -- Encounter type / code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS encounter_description,

        -- Reason (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')    AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description

    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,

    COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    CAST(COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,

    -- Strip the leading urn:uuid: or pipe‑separated identifier to obtain plain UUIDs
    REGEXP_REPLACE(patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(organization_ref, '^.*\\|', '') AS organization_id,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(provider_ref, '^.*\\|', '') AS provider_id,

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,

    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,

    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS encounter_payer_coverage,

    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM raw_enc
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
{{--
  Model: stg_acq__patients
  Source: raw_fhir_stu3.patient (id, resource JSON)
  Purpose: Transform FHIR STU3 Patient resources into the staging contract
--}}

with raw as (
    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract identifiers (SSN, DL, PPN)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
identifiers as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')                     as identifier_value,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code')       as identifier_code
    from raw r
    left join lateral json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.identifier')) i on true
),

ssn as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'SB' then identifier_value end) as ssn
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

drivers as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'DL' then identifier_value end) as drivers_license_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

passports as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'PPN' then identifier_value end) as passport_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract names (official & maiden)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
names as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.prefix[0]')               as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.given[0]')                as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.family')                  as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.suffix[0]')               as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(maiden.value, '$.family')               as maiden_name
    from raw r
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
        limit 1
    ) off on true
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
        limit 1
    ) maiden on true
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core patient fields
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
core as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.birthDate') as date)                                   as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
                then cast(substr(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'),1,10) as date)
        end                                                                                           as death_date,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                              as marital_status,
        case lower(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end                                                                                           as patient_gender,
        -- race (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as race_raw,
        -- ethnicity (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as ethnicity_raw,
        -- birthplace: city  state  country
        concat_ws('  ',
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                                               as birthplace,
        -- address fields
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')                                         as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].city')                                            as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].state')                                           as address_state,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                                      as patient_zip,
        -- latitude / longitude from geolocation extension
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_longitude
    from raw r
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map state abbreviation to full name
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
states as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Final projection matching the staging contract
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
final as (
    select
        c.patient_id,
        c.birth_date,
        c.death_date,
        s.ssn,
        d.drivers_license_number,
        p.passport_number,
        n.patient_prefix,
        n.patient_first_name,
        n.patient_last_name,
        n.patient_suffix,
        n.maiden_name,
        c.marital_status,
        case lower(c.race_raw)
            when 'white'                                 then 'white'
            when 'black or african american'            then 'black'
            when 'asian'                                 then 'asian'
            when 'american indian or alaska native'     then 'native'
            when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end                                            as race,
        case
            when lower(c.ethnicity_raw) like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end                                            as ethnicity,
        c.patient_gender,
        c.birthplace,
        c.patient_address,
        c.patient_city,
        coalesce(st.state_name, c.address_state)      as patient_state,
        cast(null as varchar)                         as patient_county,
        c.patient_zip,
        c.patient_latitude,
        c.patient_longitude,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_expenses,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_coverage
    from core c
    left join ssn s          on s.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join drivers d      on d.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join passports p    on p.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join names n        on n.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join states st      on st.state_abbreviation = c.address_state
)

select *
from final
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
with source as (
    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        patient_id,

        -- basic scalar fields
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as birth_date_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as deceased_dt,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[1].value') as ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[2].value') as drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[3].value') as passport_number,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]') as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family') as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use==\"maiden\")].family[0]') as maiden_name,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status_code,

        -- race & ethnicity via US‑Core extensions
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race\")].extension[?(@.url==\"ombCategory\")].valueCoding.display[0]'
        ) as race_display,

        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity\")].extension[?(@.url==\"ombCategory\")].valueCoding.display[0]'
        ) as ethnicity_display,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender') as gender_raw,

        -- birthplace extension
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.city[0]') as bp_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.state[0]') as bp_state,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace\")].valueAddress.country[0]') as bp_country,

        -- address fields (first address only)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state_abbr,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,

        -- geolocation inside address
        json_extract_float(
            resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation\")].extension[?(@.url==\"latitude\")].valueDecimal[0]'
        ) as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_float(
            resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url==\"http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation\")].extension[?(@.url==\"longitude\")].valueDecimal[0]'
        ) as patient_longitude

    from source
),

mapped as (
    select
        patient_id,
        cast(birth_date_str as date) as birth_date,
        case when deceased_dt is not null then cast(substr(deceased_dt,1,10) as date) end as death_date,
        ssn,
        drivers_license_number,
        passport_number,
        patient_prefix,
        patient_first_name,
        patient_last_name,
        patient_suffix,
        maiden_name,
        marital_status_code as marital_status,

        case
            when lower(race_display) like '%white%' then 'white'
            when lower(race_display) like '%black%' or lower(race_display) like '%african american%' then 'black'
            when lower(race_display) like '%asian%' then 'asian'
            when lower(race_display) like '%american indian%' or lower(race_display) like '%alaska native%' then 'native'
            when lower(race_display) like '%hawaiian%' or lower(race_display) like '%pacific islander%' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end as race,

        case
            when lower(ethnicity_display) like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end as ethnicity,

        case
            when lower(gender_raw) = 'male' then 'M'
            when lower(gender_raw) = 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as patient_gender,

        concat_ws('  ', bp_city, bp_state, bp_country) as birthplace,
        patient_address,
        patient_city,
        patient_state_abbr,
        null as patient_county,
        patient_zip,
        patient_latitude,
        patient_longitude,
        null::float as healthcare_expenses,
        null::float as healthcare_coverage
    from extracted
)

select
    m.patient_id,
    m.birth_date,
    m.death_date,
    m.ssn,
    m.drivers_license_number,
    m.passport_number,
    m.patient_prefix,
    m.patient_first_name,
    m.patient_last_name,
    m.patient_suffix,
    m.maiden_name,
    m.marital_status,
    m.race,
    m.ethnicity,
    m.patient_gender,
    m.birthplace,
    m.patient_address,
    m.patient_city,
    coalesce(s.state_name, m.patient_state_abbr) as patient_state,
    m.patient_county,
    m.patient_zip,
    m.patient_latitude,
    m.patient_longitude,
    m.healthcare_expenses,
    m.healthcare_coverage
from mapped m
left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} s
    on s.state_abbreviation = m.patient_state_abbr
```

```sql
    select
        -- identifiers
        r.encounter_id,
        -- datetime columns (UTC, naive)
        cast(r.start_str as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(
            coalesce(r.end_str, r.start_str) as timestamp
        ) as encounter_stop_datetime,
        -- patient and organization ids
        regexp_replace(r.patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        regexp_extract(r.org_ref, '\\|(.*)$', 1) as organization_id,
        -- provider lookup
        pm.provider_id,
        -- payer not available
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,
        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when r.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when r.class_code = 'IMP' then 'inpatient'
            when r.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when r.type_code = '702927004' then 'urgentcare'
                    when r.type_code in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'

        -- code and description (commas replaced by spaces)
        r.type_code as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(r.type_display, r.type_text), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,
        -- cost columns (not present in FHIR)
        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,
        -- reason
        r.reason_code as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(r.reason_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description
    from raw_enc r
    left join provider_map pm
        on lower(regexp_replace(r.provider_display, '^Dr\.\\s*', '')) = pm.name_lc
        and pm.org_id = regexp_extract(r.org_ref, '\\|(.*)$', 1)

    cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date) as encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,

    encounter_description,

    total_encounter_cost,
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
with
-- raw encounter rows
raw_encounters as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

-- extract needed fields from the JSON resource
extracted as (
    select
        encounter_id,

        -- timestamps (ISO8601 with offset -> UTC timestamp)
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as timestamp) as encounter_end_raw,

        -- patient reference without the urn:uuid: prefix
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization id from serviceProvider.reference (after the '|')
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2) as organization_id,

        -- class code (e.g., EMER, IMP, AMB)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code,

        -- primary encounter type code / description
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        -- reason (if present)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display_raw,

        -- provider display name (e.g., "Dr. Johnie961 Abshire638")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as provider_display_raw
    from raw_encounters
),

-- clean and map provider information
providers as (
    select
        Id as provider_id,
        ORGANIZATION as provider_org,
        NAME as provider_name
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
),

mapped_providers as (
    select
        e.*,
        -- strip leading "Dr. " (case‑insensitive) from the display name
        regexp_replace(e.provider_display_raw, '^Dr\.\\s*', '', 1) as provider_name_clean
    from extracted e
),

joined as (
    select
        m.encounter_id,

        -- timestamps
        m.encounter_start_datetime,
        coalesce(m.encounter_end_raw, m.encounter_start_datetime) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates
        cast(m.encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(coalesce(m.encounter_end_raw, m.encounter_start_datetime) as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        m.patient_id,
        m.organization_id,

        -- provider lookup
        p.provider_id,

        -- payer not present in FHIR STU3 Encounter
        null::varchar as payer_id,

        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when m.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when m.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when m.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when m.type_code in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when m.type_code in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,

        -- code and description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(m.type_code, ',', ' ') as encounter_code,
        replace(m.type_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        -- cost columns not available → NULL
        null::float as base_encounter_cost,
        null::float as total_encounter_cost,
        null::float as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (commas replaced)
        replace(m.reason_code_raw, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(m.reason_display_raw, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description
    from mapped_providers m
    left join providers p
        on p.provider_org = m.organization_id
        and lower(p.provider_name) = lower(m.provider_name_clean)
)

select
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
from joined
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Maps raw FHIR STU3 Encounter resources to the staging contract.
--}}

WITH raw_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        -- IDs & timestamps
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id')                                    AS encounter_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP)      AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP)      AS encounter_stop_datetime_raw,

        -- References
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')                     AS patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')             AS org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference')   AS provider_ref,

        -- Core encounter data
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                             AS encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')                 AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        )                                                                          AS encounter_description,

        -- Reason (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')               AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')            AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_encounters
),

transformed AS (
    SELECT
        -- IDs
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime_raw, encounter_start_datetime)          AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        REPLACE(patient_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                                     AS patient_id,

        CASE
            WHEN org_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION('|' IN org_ref) > 0 THEN SPLIT_PART(org_ref, '|', 2)
            ELSE REPLACE(org_ref, 'Organization?identifier=', '')
        END                                                                       AS organization_id,

        CASE
            WHEN provider_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION('|' IN provider_ref) > 0 THEN SPLIT_PART(provider_ref, '|', 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                       AS provider_id,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                                     AS payer_id,

        -- Core encounter attributes
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,

        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- Reason fields
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)          AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)           AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM transformed
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Loads FHIR STU3 Encounter resources into the staging contract.
--}}

WITH source_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,

        -- datetime fields (UTC, naive)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- date parts
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS encounter_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (urn:uuid:<id>)
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), ':', 3) AS patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (extract after final '|')
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') LIKE '%|%' THEN
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                    '\\|([^|]+)$',
                    1
                )
            ELSE
                split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '/', -1)
        END AS organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract NPI after '|')
        regexp_extract(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- payer not present in FHIR Encounter
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,

        -- encounter type code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,

        -- description: prefer text, else display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS encounter_description,

        -- cost fields not present
        NULL::DOUBLE AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (may be missing)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description

    FROM source_encounters
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM extracted
```

```sql
with
    raw as (
        select
            id as condition_id,
            resource
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    ),

    parsed as (
        select
            -- start date from onsetDateTime
            cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime')
                as timestamp
            )::date as condition_start_date,

            -- stop date from abatementDateTime (may be missing)
            cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime')
                as timestamp
            )::date as condition_stop_date,

            -- patient id from subject.reference ("urn:uuid:<id>")
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''

            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            ) as condition_description

        from raw
    )

    condition_code,
    condition_description
from parsed
```

```sql
with
proc as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') as start_ts_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') as end_ts_str,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as proc_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as proc_desc,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_ref
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

proc_clean as (
    select
        cast(start_ts_str as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(end_ts_str as timestamp) as procedure_stop_datetime,
        replace(patient_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        replace(encounter_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') as encounter_id,
        proc_code as procedure_code,
        proc_desc as procedure_description,
        null::float as procedure_base_cost,
        replace(reason_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') as reason_id
    from proc
),

condition_lookup as (
    select
        id as condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as reason_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
),

joined as (
    select
        p.*,
        c.reason_code,
        c.reason_description
    from proc_clean p
    left join condition_lookup c
        on p.reason_id = c.condition_id
)

select
    procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    reason_code as procedure_reason_code,
    reason_description as procedure_reason_description
from joined
```

```sql
with
    procedures as (
        select
            id as procedure_id,
            resource
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
    ),

    proc_parsed as (
        select
            cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start') as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime,
            cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')   as timestamp) as procedure_stop_datetime,
            regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
            regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'), '^urn:uuid:', '') as encounter_id,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                               as procedure_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            )                                                                                 as procedure_description,
            -- first reasonReference, if present
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''
            )                                                                                 as reason_ref_id
        from procedures
    ),

    condition_lookup as (
        select
            id as condition_id,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')  as condition_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            )                                                      as condition_description
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    ),

    joined as (
        select
            p.procedure_start_datetime,
            p.procedure_stop_datetime,
            p.patient_id,
            p.encounter_id,
            p.procedure_code,
            p.procedure_description,
            cast(null as double)                               as procedure_base_cost,
            c.condition_code                                   as procedure_reason_code,
            c.condition_description                            as procedure_reason_description
        from proc_parsed p
        left join condition_lookup c
            on p.reason_ref_id = c.condition_id
    )

select
    procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date)   as procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
from joined
```

```sql
with
-- extract procedure level fields
proc as (
    select
        -- start / stop timestamps (fallback to performedDateTime if period missing)
        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        replace(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        replace(json_extract(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as encounter_id,

        -- procedure coding
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as procedure_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as procedure_description,

        -- cost not present in FHIR Procedure – set to NULL (float)
        null::double as procedure_base_cost,

        -- first reasonReference id (if any) – strip prefix for join to Condition
        replace(
            json_extract(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

-- extract condition level fields needed for procedure reasons
cond as (
    select
        id,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as reason_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as reason_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
)

select
    proc.procedure_start_datetime,
    proc.procedure_start_datetime::date as procedure_start_date,
    proc.procedure_stop_datetime,
    proc.procedure_stop_datetime::date as procedure_stop_date,
    proc.patient_id,
    proc.encounter_id,
    proc.procedure_code,
    proc.procedure_description,
    proc.procedure_base_cost,
    cond.reason_code as procedure_reason_code,
    cond.reason_description as procedure_reason_description
from proc
left join cond
    on proc.reason_condition_id = cond.id
```

```sql
{{-
/*
Model: stg_acq__procedures
Purpose: Transform raw FHIR STU3 Procedure resources into the acquirer’s
staging contract for procedures.
*/
-}}

WITH raw_procedures AS (

    SELECT
        -- timestamps (may be performedPeriod or performedDateTime)
        COALESCE(
            json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
            json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS start_ts,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
            json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS end_ts,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the URN prefix)
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,

        -- procedure code & description (prefer coding display, fallback to text)
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')          AS procedure_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.text')
        )                                                      AS procedure_description,

        -- first reason reference (may be NULL)
        json_extract(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

-- clean up the reason reference to obtain the condition id (or NULL)
proc_with_reason AS (
    SELECT
        start_ts,
        end_ts,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        procedure_code,
        procedure_description,
        CASE
            WHEN reason_ref_raw IS NOT NULL
            THEN REPLACE(reason_ref_raw, 'urn:uuid:', '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS reason_condition_id
    FROM raw_procedures
),

-- extract condition information needed for reason fields
condition_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        id AS condition_id,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')     AS reason_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
),

-- combine procedure with optional reason information
joined AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(start_ts AS TIMESTAMP)               AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(end_ts   AS TIMESTAMP)               AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        procedure_code,
        procedure_description,

)

    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE)   AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM joined
```
