```sql
with
    -- raw source rows
    src as (
        select
            id,
            resource
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    ),

    -- observations that have a direct value (valueQuantity, valueString, valueCodeableConcept)
    main_obs as (
        select
            cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as timestamp)               as observation_datetime,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')                                 as patient_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')                                 as encounter_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')                        as observation_category,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                               as observation_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            )                                                                                   as observation_description,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            )                                                                                   as observation_value,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                               as observation_units,
            case
                when json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')) is not null then 'numeric'
                when json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueString')) is not null           then 'text'
                when json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')) is not null then 'text'
                else null
            end                                                                                as observation_value_type
        from src
        where
            json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') is not null
            or json_extract(resource, '$.valueString') is not null
            or json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') is not null
    ),

    -- observations that are represented as components (e.g., survey answers)
    component_obs as (
        select
            cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as timestamp)               as observation_datetime,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')                                 as patient_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')                                 as encounter_ref,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')                        as observation_category,
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')                             as observation_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            )                                                                                   as observation_description,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
                json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString'),
                json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            )                                                                                   as observation_value,
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                             as observation_units,
            case
                when json_type(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')) is not null then 'numeric'
                when json_type(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueString')) is not null           then 'text'
                when json_type(json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')) is not null then 'text'
                else null
            end                                                                                as observation_value_type
        from src
        cross join lateral json_each(resource, '$.component') as comp
    ),

    -- combine main and component observations
    union_obs as (
        select * from main_obs
        union all
        select * from component_obs
    )

select
    observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date)                                   as observation_date,
    regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                         as patient_id,
    regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                       as encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
from union_obs
```

```sql
with source as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

parsed as (
    select
        -- datetime of observation
        cast(json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as timestamp) as observation_datetime,

        -- patient and encounter references (URNs)
        json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference') as subject_ref,
        json_extract(resource, '$.context.reference') as encounter_ref,

        -- category and code
        json_extract(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') as observation_category,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as observation_code,

        -- description (prefer free‑text, fall back to coding display)
        coalesce(
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) as observation_description,

        -- possible value locations
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')        as value_quantity,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')         as value_units,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')  as value_codeable_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueString')                as value_string
    from source
),

final as (
    select
        observation_datetime,
        cast(observation_datetime as date)                                   as observation_date,
        regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                        as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                      as encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        case
            when value_quantity is not null then cast(value_quantity as varchar)
            when value_codeable_text is not null then value_codeable_text
            else value_string
        end                                                                     as observation_value,
        case
            when value_quantity is not null then value_units
            else null
        end                                                                     as observation_units,
        case
            when value_quantity is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                                     as observation_value_type
    from parsed
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
WITH raw_observations AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

-- Pull out the fields that are always present and keep the raw component JSON
exploded AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')            AS effective_dt,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')                      AS issued_dt,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        )                                                             AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        )                                                             AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')   AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')         AS top_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')                  AS top_desc,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')     AS top_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')       AS top_value_quantity,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')        AS top_units,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text') AS top_value_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')               AS top_value_string,
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')                         AS component_json
    FROM raw_observations
),

-- Observations that have a component array – explode each component to its own row
component_expanded AS (
    SELECT
        effective_dt,
        issued_dt,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')   AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                                      AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueString')
        )                                                      AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')  AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                 THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                    AS observation_value_type
    FROM exploded,
    LATERAL json_each(component_json) AS c
    WHERE json_typeof(component_json) = 'array'
),

-- Observations without components – keep a single row per observation
non_component AS (
    SELECT
        effective_dt,
        issued_dt,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        top_code                                            AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(top_desc, top_display)                     AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(top_value_quantity, top_value_text, top_value_string) AS observation_value,
        top_units                                           AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN top_value_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM exploded
    WHERE json_typeof(component_json) IS NULL
       OR json_typeof(component_json) = 'null'
)

SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(effective_dt, issued_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(COALESCE(effective_dt, issued_dt) AS DATE)      AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM component_expanded

UNION ALL

SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(effective_dt, issued_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(COALESCE(effective_dt, issued_dt) AS DATE)      AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM non_component
```

```sql
with
raw_observations as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

parsed as (
    select
        -- datetime
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
        ) as observation_datetime_str,

        -- patient and encounter references
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as encounter_ref,

        -- category code (e.g. "laboratory", "survey")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') as observation_category,

        -- observation code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as observation_code,

        -- description: prefer code.text, else coding display
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) as observation_description,

        -- value handling
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')   as value_quantity,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')    as value_units,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text') as value_codeable_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')          as value_string
    from raw_observations
)

select
    cast(observation_datetime_str as timestamp)                     as observation_datetime,
    cast(cast(observation_datetime_str as timestamp) as date)       as observation_date,
    regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                  as patient_id,
    regexp_replace(encounter_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '')                as encounter_id,
    observation_category                                            as observation_category,
    observation_code                                                as observation_code,
    observation_description                                         as observation_description,
    coalesce(
        value_quantity,
        value_codeable_text,
        value_string
    )                                                               as observation_value,
    value_units                                                     as observation_units,
    case
        when value_quantity is not null then 'numeric'
        else 'text'
    end                                                             as observation_value_type
from parsed
```

```sql
with src as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
)

select
    -- Start date from assertedDate (cast to DATE, dropping time)
    cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') as date) as allergy_start_date,

    -- No explicit stop/abatement date in the sample; set NULL
    null::date as allergy_stop_date,

    -- Patient ID: strip the leading "urn:uuid:"
    regexp_replace(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
        '^urn:uuid:',
        ''
    ) as patient_id,

    -- Encounter ID if present; otherwise NULL (also strip leading urn:uuid:)
    regexp_replace(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
        '^urn:uuid:',
        ''
    ) as encounter_id,

    -- Allergy code and system (first coding entry)
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')        as allergy_code,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')      as allergy_code_system,

    -- Description prefers the free‑text field, falls back to display
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
    ) as allergy_description,

    -- Type (e.g., "allergy")
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,

    -- Category (first entry of the category array)
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,

    -- Reaction 1 – code, description, severity (if present)
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].substance.coding[0].code')          as reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].substance.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')
    ) as reaction_1_description,

    ) as reaction_2_description,
```

- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
with raw as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

parent as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')               as effective_dt,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')              as subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')              as encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')      as category_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')            as obs_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')                      as obs_description,
        case
            when json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') is not null then json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            when json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') is not null then json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            when json_extract(resource, '$.valueString') is not null then json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
            else null
        end                                                               as obs_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')            as obs_units,
        case
            when json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                               as obs_value_type,
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')                             as component_json
    from raw
),

component_rows as (
    select
        p.effective_dt,
        p.subject_ref,
        p.encounter_ref,
        p.category_code,
        json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code.coding[0].code')            as obs_code,
        json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code.text')                      as obs_description,
        case
            when json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity') is not null then json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            when json_extract(c.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept') is not null then json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            when json_extract(c.value, '$.valueString') is not null then json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueString')
            else null
        end                                                               as obs_value,
        json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit')            as obs_units,
        case
            when json_extract(c.value, '$.valueQuantity') is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end                                                               as obs_value_type
    from parent p
    join lateral json_each(p.component_json) as c on true
    where json_array_length(p.component_json) > 0
),

parent_rows as (
    select
        effective_dt,
        subject_ref,
        encounter_ref,
        category_code,
        obs_code,
        obs_description,
        obs_value,
        obs_units,
        obs_value_type
    from parent
    where json_array_length(component_json) = 0 or component_json is null
),

unioned as (
    select * from component_rows
    union all
    select * from parent_rows
)

select
    cast(effective_dt as timestamp)                                              as observation_datetime,
    cast(cast(effective_dt as timestamp) as date)                                 as observation_date,
    replace(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                                         as patient_id,
    replace(encounter_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                                       as encounter_id,
    category_code                                                                 as observation_category,
    obs_code                                                                      as observation_code,
    replace(obs_description, ',', ' ')                                            as observation_description,
    case
        when obs_value_type = 'numeric' and obs_value is not null then
            printf('%.1f', cast(obs_value as double))
        else replace(obs_value, ',', ' ')
    end                                                                          as observation_value,
    obs_units                                                                     as observation_units,
    obs_value_type                                                                as observation_value_type
from unioned
```

```sql
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')                         AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')                               AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        )                                                                                     AS observation_description,
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')                                                AS component_json
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}

obs_no_comp AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE)                                                   AS observation_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        REPLACE(observation_description, ',', ' ')                                          AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                sprintf('%.1f', json_extract_double(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'))
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'), ',', ' ')
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                                  AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                                  AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                                  AS observation_value_type
    FROM base
    WHERE component_json IS NULL

),

    SELECT
        b.observation_datetime,
        CAST(b.observation_datetime AS DATE)                                                AS observation_date,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.code.coding[0].code')                            AS observation_code,
        REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',', ' '
        )                                                                                  AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(c.comp_json, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                sprintf('%.1f', json_extract_double(c.comp_json, '$.valueQuantity.value'))
            WHEN json_extract(c.comp_json, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN
                REPLACE(json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.valueString'), ',', ' ')
            WHEN json_extract(c.comp_json, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                    json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                                  AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(c.comp_json, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                json_extract_string(c.comp_json, '$.valueQuantity.unit')
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                                  AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(c.comp_json, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                                  AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(b.component_json) AS c(comp_index, comp_json)
```

```sql
with source_allergies as (
    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
)

select
    -- start date (date portion of assertedDate)
    cast(substr(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.assertedDate'), 1, 10) as date) as allergy_start_date,
    -- stop date (abatementDate if present)
    case
        when json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.abatementDate') is not null
        then cast(substr(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.abatementDate'), 1, 10) as date)
        else cast(null as date)
    end as allergy_stop_date,
    -- patient identifier (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
    replace(json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.patient.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
    -- encounter not captured in AllergyIntolerance, set to null
    null::varchar as encounter_id,
    -- allergy code and system
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as allergy_code_system,
    -- description prefers display, falls back to code.text
    coalesce(
        json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.code.text')
    ) as allergy_description,
    -- type (allergy/intolerance)
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
    -- first category entry
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,
    -- first reaction (if any)
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_1_code,
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_1_description,
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') as reaction_1_severity,
    -- second reaction (if any)
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_2_code,
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_2_description,
    json_extract_scalar(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') as reaction_2_severity
from source_allergies
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')                AS asserted_dt,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference')          AS patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')        AS allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')      AS allergy_code_system_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')                 AS code_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')    AS code_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type')                      AS allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]')               AS allergy_category,
        -- reactions – may be absent in many resources
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')          AS reaction1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')      AS reaction1_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')                               AS reaction1_severity,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')          AS reaction2_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')      AS reaction2_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')                               AS reaction2_severity

)

    reaction1_code                                                                  AS reaction_1_code,

    reaction1_severity                                                              AS reaction_1_severity,
    reaction2_code                                                                  AS reaction_2_code,
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
with allergies as (
    select
        cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate'), 1, 10) as date) as allergy_start_date,
        null::date as allergy_stop_date,
        regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'), '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') as asserted_timestamp,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') as code_system_url,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as allergy_description_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type') as allergy_type,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0]') as allergy_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_1_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_1_description_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity') as reaction_1_severity_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code') as reaction_2_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display') as reaction_2_description_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity') as reaction_2_severity_raw
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounters as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as period_start
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

joined as (
    select
        a.*,
        e.encounter_id
    from allergies a
    left join encounters e
        on e.period_start = a.asserted_timestamp
)

select
    allergy_start_date,
    allergy_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    allergy_code,
    case
        when code_system_url like '%snomed.info/sct%' then 'SNOMED-CT'
        when code_system_url like '%rxnorm%' then 'RxNorm'
        else null
    end as allergy_code_system,
    replace(allergy_description_raw, ',', ' ') as allergy_description,
    allergy_type,
    allergy_category,
    reaction_1_code,
    replace(reaction_1_description_raw, ',', ' ') as reaction_1_description,
    upper(reaction_1_severity_raw) as reaction_1_severity,
    reaction_2_code,
    replace(reaction_2_description_raw, ',', ' ') as reaction_2_description,
    upper(reaction_2_severity_raw) as reaction_2_severity
from joined
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
with
    raw_allergies as (
        select
            -- raw JSON extraction
            json_extract(resource, '$.assertedDate')::varchar                as asserted_ts,
            substr(json_extract(resource, '$.assertedDate')::varchar,1,10)   as start_date_str,
            cast(substr(json_extract(resource, '$.assertedDate')::varchar,1,10) as date) 
                                                                          as allergy_start_date,
            null::date                                                     as allergy_stop_date,
            replace(json_extract(resource, '$.patient.reference')::varchar, 'urn:uuid:', '') 
                                                                          as patient_id,
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::varchar       as allergy_code,
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')::varchar     as code_system_url,
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')::varchar   as allergy_description,
            json_extract(resource, '$.type')::varchar                      as allergy_type,
            json_extract(resource, '$.category[0]')::varchar               as allergy_category,
            json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')::varchar 
                                                                          as reaction_1_code,
            replace(
                json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')::varchar,
                ',', ' '
            )                                                             as reaction_1_description,
            upper(json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')::varchar) 
                                                                          as reaction_1_severity,
            json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code')::varchar 
                                                                          as reaction_2_code,
            replace(
                json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display')::varchar,
                ',', ' '
            )                                                             as reaction_2_description,
            upper(json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')::varchar) 
                                                                          as reaction_2_severity
        from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
    ),

    mapped_allergies as (
        select
            allergy_start_date,
            allergy_stop_date,
            patient_id,
            allergy_code,
            case
                when code_system_url like '%snomed.info%' then 'SNOMED-CT'
                when code_system_url like '%rxnorm%'      then 'RxNorm'
                else null
            end                                           as allergy_code_system,
            allergy_description,
            allergy_type,
            allergy_category,
            reaction_1_code,
            reaction_1_description,
            reaction_1_severity,
            reaction_2_code,
            reaction_2_description,
            reaction_2_severity,
            asserted_ts
        from raw_allergies
    )

select
    ma.allergy_start_date,
    ma.allergy_stop_date,
    ma.patient_id,
    e.id as encounter_id,
    ma.allergy_code,
    ma.allergy_code_system,
    ma.allergy_description,
    ma.allergy_type,
    ma.allergy_category,
    ma.reaction_1_code,
    ma.reaction_1_description,
    ma.reaction_1_severity,
    ma.reaction_2_code,
    ma.reaction_2_description,
    ma.reaction_2_severity
from mapped_allergies ma
left join {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} e
    on json_extract(e.resource, '$.period.start')::varchar = ma.asserted_ts
```

```sql
with source_members as (

        "Member id"::varchar                     as patient_id,

        -- Dates
        cast("Date of birth" as date)            as birth_date,
        case
            when "Date of death" is not null
                 and trim("Date of death") <> '' then cast("Date of death" as date)
            else null
        end                                      as death_date,

        -- Demographics (not present in the claims feed → null)
        null::varchar                             as ssn,
        null::varchar                             as drivers_license_number,
        null::varchar                             as passport_number,
        null::varchar                             as patient_prefix,

        -- Name parsing – first token = first name, last token = last name
        split_part("Name", ' ', 1)                as patient_first_name,
        split_part("Name", ' ', -1)               as patient_last_name,

        null::varchar                             as patient_suffix,
        null::varchar                             as maiden_name,
        null::varchar                             as marital_status,

        -- Race / Ethnicity / Gender
        "Race code"                               as race,
        "Ethnicity"                               as ethnicity,
        "Gender code"                             as patient_gender,

        -- Location (partial – only home fields are available)
        null::varchar                             as birthplace,
        null::varchar                             as patient_address,
        null::varchar                             as patient_city,
        "Home_State"                              as patient_state,
        "Home_County"                             as patient_county,

        null::double                               as patient_latitude,
        null::double                               as patient_longitude,
        null::double                               as healthcare_expenses,
        null::double                               as healthcare_coverage

    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}

)
```

- raw_claims.members has one row per member: "Member id" is the patient id, "Date of birth", "Date of death", "Gender code", "Race code" and "Ethnicity" are already written as the acquirer writes them.
- "Name" is first name, a space, last name. State, county and zip are the Home_ columns. Everything else in the contract is not in the export: NULL.

```sql
with
raw_members as (
    select
        -- identifiers
        "Member id" as patient_id,

        -- dates (convert from varchar, treat empty strings as null)
        nullif("Date of birth", '')::date as birth_date,
        nullif("Date of death", '')::date as death_date,

        -- demographics
        null as ssn,
        null as drivers_license_number,
        null as passport_number,
        null as patient_prefix,

        split_part("Name", ' ', 1) as patient_first_name,
        split_part("Name", ' ', 2) as patient_last_name,

        null as patient_suffix,
        null as maiden_name,
        null as marital_status,

        "Race code" as race,
        "Ethnicity" as ethnicity,
        "Gender code" as patient_gender,

        null as birthplace,
        null as patient_address,
        null as patient_city,

        -- state: prefer abbreviation if mapping exists
        coalesce(st.state_abbreviation, "Home_State") as patient_state,

        "Home_County" as patient_county,
        nullif("Home_Zip code", '') as patient_zip,

        null as patient_latitude,
        null as patient_longitude,
        null as healthcare_expenses,
        null as healthcare_coverage

    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }} as m
    left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as st
        on st.state_name = m."Home_State"
)

select
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    cast(patient_latitude as double) as patient_latitude,
    cast(patient_longitude as double) as patient_longitude,
    cast(healthcare_expenses as double) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(healthcare_coverage as double) as healthcare_coverage
from raw_members
```

## Mapping hints
- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".
- The start date is "Service (from) date"; the stop date is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop date. There is no encounter id: NULL.
text:
```sql
{{--
stg_acq__conditions
Transforms acquired claims data into the standard conditions staging contract.
--}}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE "Diagnosis code" IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    TRY_CAST("Service (from) date" AS DATE)                         AS condition_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN "Service to date" = '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
        ELSE TRY_CAST("Service to date" AS DATE)
    END                                                            AS condition_stop_date,
    "Patient account number"                                        AS patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                          AS encounter_id,
    "Diagnosis code"                                                AS condition_code,
    "Diagnosis description"                                         AS condition_description
FROM src
```

- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".

```sql
WITH cte_conditions AS (
    SELECT
        CAST("Service (from) date" AS DATE) AS condition_start_date,
        CASE
            WHEN "Service to date" = '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST("Service to date" AS DATE)
        END AS condition_stop_date,
        "Patient account number" AS patient_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        "Diagnosis code" AS condition_code,
        "Diagnosis description" AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE "Diagnosis code" IS NOT NULL
      AND "Diagnosis code" <> ''
)

SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM cte_conditions
```

```sql
WITH source_claims AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
)

SELECT
    -- start datetime (midnight UTC) and date
    CAST("Claim service start date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST("Claim service start date" AS DATE)      AS procedure_start_date,

    -- stop datetime (midnight UTC) and date
    CAST("Claim service end date"   AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST("Claim service end date"   AS DATE)      AS procedure_stop_date,

    -- identifiers
    "Patient account number"      AS patient_id,
    "Claim unique identifier"     AS encounter_id,

    -- procedure details
    "Procedure code"              AS procedure_code,
    "Procedure description"       AS procedure_description,

    -- cost (use submitted amount as base cost)
    TRY_CAST("Claim total submitted amount" AS DOUBLE) AS procedure_base_cost,

    -- reason (diagnosis)
    "Diagnosis code"              AS procedure_reason_code,
    "Diagnosis description"       AS procedure_reason_description

FROM source_claims
```

```sql
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH raw_claims AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
),

renamed AS (
    SELECT
        -- start / stop datetimes (date strings cast to timestamp at midnight UTC)
        CAST("Claim service start date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST("Claim service end date"   AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,

        -- identifiers
        "Patient account number"   AS patient_id,
        "Claim unique identifier" AS encounter_id,

        -- procedure details
        "Procedure code"        AS procedure_code,
        "Procedure description" AS procedure_description,
        TRY_CAST("Claim total submitted amount" AS DOUBLE) AS procedure_base_cost,

        -- reason (diagnosis) details
        "Diagnosis code"        AS procedure_reason_code,
        "Diagnosis description" AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM raw_claims
),

with_dates AS (
    SELECT
        procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
        procedure_stop_datetime,
        CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        procedure_code,
        procedure_description,
        procedure_base_cost,
        procedure_reason_code,
        procedure_reason_description
    FROM renamed
)

SELECT *
FROM with_dates
```

```sql
with raw_claims as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    where "Claim type" = 'pharmacy'
),

renamed as (
    select
        -- datetime columns (assume midnight UTC)
        cast("Claim service start date" as timestamp) as medication_start_datetime,
        cast("Claim service end date" as timestamp) as medication_stop_datetime,

        -- identifiers
        "Patient account number" as patient_id,
        "Claim primary payer identifier" as payer_id,
        coalesce("RX service reference number", "Claim unique identifier") as encounter_id,

        -- medication details
        "National drug code" as medication_code,
        null::varchar as medication_description,

        try_cast("Drug cost" as double) as medication_base_cost,
        try_cast("Claim amount paid to provider" as double) as medication_payer_coverage,
        try_cast("Quantity dispensed" as double) as dispenses,
        try_cast("Line payment amount" as double) as medication_total_cost,

        -- reason fields
        "Diagnosis code" as medication_reason_code,
        "Diagnosis description" as medication_reason_description
    from raw_claims
),

with_dates as (
    select
        medication_start_datetime,
        cast(medication_start_datetime as date) as medication_start_date,
        medication_stop_datetime,
        cast(medication_stop_datetime as date) as medication_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_id,
        medication_code,
        medication_description,
        medication_base_cost,
        medication_payer_coverage,
        dispenses,
        medication_total_cost,
        medication_reason_code,
        medication_reason_description
    from renamed
)

select *
from with_dates
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
),

renamed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(CAST("Claim service start date" AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(CAST("Claim service end date" AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        "Patient account number"                                   AS patient_id,
        "Claim unique identifier"                                 AS encounter_id,
        "Procedure code"                                          AS procedure_code,
        "Procedure description"                                   AS procedure_description,
        TRY_CAST("Line payment amount" AS DOUBLE)                AS procedure_base_cost,
        "Diagnosis code"                                          AS procedure_reason_code,
        "Diagnosis description"                                   AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM renamed
```

```sql
{{--
    Model: stg_acq__medications
    Purpose: Transform raw claim pharmacy lines into the standard medication staging contract.
--}}

WITH raw_claims AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
),

renamed AS (
    SELECT
        -- datetime fields (date strings cast to timestamp at midnight UTC)
        TRY_CAST("Claim service start date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
        TRY_CAST("Claim service end date"   AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,

        -- identifiers
        "Patient account number"            AS patient_id,
        "Claim primary payer identifier"   AS payer_id,
        "Claim unique identifier"          AS encounter_id,

        -- medication codes / description
        "National drug code"               AS medication_code,
        COALESCE("Procedure description", NULL) AS medication_description,

        -- cost / coverage fields (strings to numeric, empty strings become NULL)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Drug cost", '')                     AS DOUBLE) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Claim primary payer paid amount", '') AS DOUBLE) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Quantity dispensed", '')            AS DOUBLE) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Line payment amount", '')          AS DOUBLE) AS medication_total_cost,

        -- reason (diagnosis) fields
        "Diagnosis code"        AS medication_reason_code,
        "Diagnosis description" AS medication_reason_description
    FROM raw_claims
),

with_dates AS (
    SELECT
        medication_start_datetime,
        CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
        medication_stop_datetime,
        CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_id,
        medication_code,
        medication_description,
        medication_base_cost,
        medication_payer_coverage,
        dispenses,
        medication_total_cost,
        medication_reason_code,
        medication_reason_description
    FROM renamed
)

SELECT *
FROM with_dates
```

```sql
{{-
-- stg_acq__medications
-- Map raw claim pharmacy lines to the standard medication staging contract
-}}
WITH raw_claims AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
),

renamed AS (
    SELECT
        -- Datetime fields (date strings cast to timestamp, interpreted as UTC midnight)
        CAST(NULLIF("Claim service start date", '') AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
        CAST(NULLIF("Claim service end date", '') AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,

        -- Core identifiers
        "Patient account number"           AS patient_id,
        "Claim payer identifier"          AS payer_id,
        "Claim unique identifier"         AS encounter_id,

        -- Medication details
        "National drug code"               AS medication_code,
        NULL::VARCHAR                      AS medication_description,  -- not supplied in source
        CAST(NULLIF("Drug cost", '') AS DOUBLE)                     AS medication_base_cost,
        CAST(NULLIF("Line primary payer paid amount", '') AS DOUBLE) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        CAST(NULLIF("Quantity dispensed", '') AS DOUBLE)            AS dispenses,
        CAST(NULLIF("Line payment amount", '') AS DOUBLE)           AS medication_total_cost,

        -- Reason for medication
        "Diagnosis code"                  AS medication_reason_code,
        "Diagnosis description"           AS medication_reason_description
    FROM raw_claims
)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM renamed
```

## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.

text:
```sql
with
raw_claims as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
),

filtered as (
    select
        -- dates as strings
        "Service (from) date" as service_from_date,
        "Service to date" as service_to_date,
        "Patient account number" as patient_account_number,
        "National drug code" as ndc,
        "Drug cost" as drug_cost,
        "Claim primary payer paid amount" as primary_payer_paid_amount,
        "Quantity dispensed" as quantity_dispensed,
        "Line payment amount" as line_payment_amount,
        "Diagnosis code" as diagnosis_code,
        "Diagnosis description" as diagnosis_description
    from raw_claims
    where 
        "National drug code" is not null
        and trim("National drug code") <> ''
),

converted as (
    select
        -- start datetime and date
        cast(service_from_date as timestamp) as medication_start_datetime,
        cast(service_from_date as date) as medication_start_date,

        -- stop datetime and date, handling sentinel 1969-12-31
        case
            when service_to_date = '1969-12-31' then null
            else cast(service_to_date as timestamp)
        end as medication_stop_datetime,
        case
            when service_to_date = '1969-12-31' then null
            else cast(service_to_date as date)
        end as medication_stop_date,

        -- identifiers
        patient_account_number as patient_id,
        null::varchar as payer_id,
        null::varchar as encounter_id,

        -- medication details
        ndc as medication_code,
        null::varchar as medication_description,
        try_cast(drug_cost as double) as medication_base_cost,
        try_cast(primary_payer_paid_amount as double) as medication_payer_coverage,
        try_cast(quantity_dispensed as double) as dispenses,
        try_cast(line_payment_amount as double) as medication_total_cost,

        -- reason
        diagnosis_code as medication_reason_code,
        diagnosis_description as medication_reason_description
    from filtered
)

select
    medication_start_datetime,
    medication_start_date,
    medication_stop_datetime,
    medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
from converted
```

## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.
- The reason is "Diagnosis code" and "Diagnosis description" of the same line. The payer identifier of the export is not one of the acquirer's payer ids and there is no encounter id: NULL for both.
text:
```sql
{{--
stg_acq__medications
Transforms acquired claims data into the staging contract for medications.
--}}

with raw as (

    select
        -- Dates
        "Service (from) date" as service_from_date,
        "Service to date" as service_to_date,

        -- Identifiers
        "Patient account number" as patient_id,
        -- No encounter information in the source
        null::varchar as encounter_id,

        -- Medication details
        "National drug code" as medication_code,
        null::varchar as medication_description,  -- not provided in source

        -- Cost fields (stored as VARCHAR, may be empty)
        nullif("Drug cost", '') as drug_cost,
        nullif("Claim primary payer paid amount", '') as payer_paid_amount,
        nullif("Line payment amount", '') as line_payment_amount,

        -- Dispense count
        nullif("Quantity dispensed", '') as quantity_dispensed,

        -- Reason for medication
        nullif("Diagnosis code", '') as diagnosis_code,
        nullif("Diagnosis description", '') as diagnosis_description

    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}

)

select
    -- start datetime and date
    cast(service_from_date as timestamp)                as medication_start_datetime,
    cast(service_from_date as date)                     as medication_start_date,

    -- stop datetime and date (null if placeholder date)
    case when service_to_date = '1969-12-31'
         then null
         else cast(service_to_date as timestamp)
    end                                                as medication_stop_datetime,
    case when service_to_date = '1969-12-31'
         then null
         else cast(service_to_date as date)
    end                                                as medication_stop_date,

    -- identifiers
    patient_id,
    null::varchar                                      as payer_id,      -- not available / not mapped
    encounter_id,

    -- medication code/description
    medication_code,
    medication_description,

    -- monetary values
    cast(nullif(drug_cost, '') as double)              as medication_base_cost,
    cast(nullif(payer_paid_amount, '') as double)      as medication_payer_coverage,
    cast(nullif(quantity_dispensed, '') as double)     as dispenses,
    cast(nullif(line_payment_amount, '') as double)    as medication_total_cost,

    -- reason fields
    diagnosis_code                                      as medication_reason_code,
    diagnosis_description                               as medication_reason_description

from raw
```

```sql
with raw as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}
),

parsed as (
    select
        id as patient_id,

        -- birth and death dates (format e.g. 07-Aug-1918)
        to_date(trim(birthdate), '%d-%b-%Y') as birth_date,
        case
            when trim(deathdate) = '' or deathdate is null then null
            else to_date(trim(deathdate), '%d-%b-%Y')
        end as death_date,

        ssn,
        drivers as drivers_license_number,
        passport as passport_number,
        prefix as patient_prefix,

        -- full_name is "LastName, FirstName"
        trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)) as patient_last_name,
        trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 2)) as patient_first_name,

        suffix as patient_suffix,
        maiden as maiden_name,
        marital as marital_status,
        race,
        ethnicity,
        gender as patient_gender,
        birthplace,

        address as patient_address,

        -- city_state_zip is "City, State ZIP" (ZIP optional)
        trim(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)) as patient_city,
        trim(split_part(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 2), ' ', 1)) as patient_state,
        nullif(trim(split_part(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 2), ' ', 2)), '') as patient_zip,

        county as patient_county,

        cast(lat as double) as patient_latitude,
        cast(lon as double) as patient_longitude,

        cast(healthcare_expenses as double) as healthcare_expenses,
        cast(healthcare_coverage as double) as healthcare_coverage
    from raw
)

select
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
from parsed
```

```sql
WITH raw_patients AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        -- identifiers
        id AS patient_id,

        -- dates (raw format e.g. 07-Aug-1918)
        CAST(strptime(birthdate, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CASE
            WHEN deathdate IS NULL OR trim(deathdate) = ''
                THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(strptime(deathdate, '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE)
        END AS death_date,

        -- personal identifiers
        ssn,
        drivers AS drivers_license_number,
        passport AS passport_number,
        prefix AS patient_prefix,
        TRIM(split_part(full_name, ',', 2)) AS patient_first_name,
        TRIM(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)) AS patient_last_name,
        suffix AS patient_suffix,
        maiden AS maiden_name,
        marital AS marital_status,
        race,
        ethnicity,
        gender AS patient_gender,
        birthplace,

        -- address parsing
        address AS patient_address,

        TRIM(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)) AS parsed_city,
        TRIM(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 2)) AS parsed_state_zip,

        county AS patient_county,

        -- latitude / longitude
        CAST(lat AS DOUBLE) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(lon AS DOUBLE) AS patient_longitude,

        -- financials
        CAST(healthcare_expenses AS DOUBLE) AS healthcare_expenses,
        CAST(healthcare_coverage AS DOUBLE) AS healthcare_coverage

    FROM raw_patients
)

, split_state_zip AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        -- state (may be abbreviation or full name)
        TRIM(split_part(parsed_state_zip, ' ', 1)) AS raw_state,
        -- zip (optional, 5‑digit)
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_matches(parsed_state_zip, '\\d{5}$')
                THEN regexp_extract(parsed_state_zip, '(\\d{5})$')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS patient_zip,
        parsed_city AS patient_city
    FROM parsed
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    COALESCE(state_map.state_name, raw_state) AS patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
FROM split_state_zip
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS state_map
    ON state_map.state_abbreviation = split_state_zip.raw_state
```

```sql
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}
),

name_split AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        split_part(full_name, ',', 1) AS last_name_raw,
        split_part(full_name, ',', 2) AS first_name_raw,
        split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1) AS city_raw,
        split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 2) AS state_zip_raw
    FROM raw
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- identifiers
        id AS patient_id,

        -- dates (format e.g. 07-Aug-1918)
        to_timestamp(birthdate, 'DD-Mon-YYYY')::DATE AS birth_date,
        CASE
            WHEN deathdate IS NULL OR trim(deathdate) = ''
                THEN NULL
            ELSE to_timestamp(deathdate, 'DD-Mon-YYYY')::DATE
        END AS death_date,

        -- personal identifiers
        ssn,
        drivers AS drivers_license_number,
        passport AS passport_number,
        prefix AS patient_prefix,
        trim(first_name_raw) AS patient_first_name,
        trim(last_name_raw) AS patient_last_name,
        suffix AS patient_suffix,
        maiden AS maiden_name,
        marital AS marital_status,
        race,
        ethnicity,
        gender AS patient_gender,
        birthplace,

        -- address fields
        address AS patient_address,
        trim(city_raw) AS patient_city,
        trim(split_part(state_zip_raw, ' ', 1)) AS patient_state,
        NULLIF(trim(split_part(state_zip_raw, ' ', 2)), '') AS patient_zip,
        county AS patient_county,

        -- geo & financial
        CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude,
        healthcare_expenses,
        healthcare_coverage
    FROM name_split
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,

    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed
```

```sql
with
raw_enc as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),

raw_chg as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}
),

joined as (
    select
        e.id as encounter_id,
        e.start_date,
        e.start_time,
        e.stop_date,
        e.stop_time,
        e.patient as patient_id,
        e.organization as organization_id,
        e.provider as provider_id,
        e.payer as payer_id,
        e.encounterclass as encounter_class,
        e.code_display,
        e.reason,
        c.base_encounter_cost,
        c.total_claim_cost,
        c.payer_coverage
    from raw_enc e
    left join raw_chg c
        on e.id = c.encounter_id
),

parsed as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        -- combine date and time strings into timestamps (assumed UTC)
        strptime(start_date || ' ' || start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as encounter_start_datetime,
        strptime(stop_date || ' ' || stop_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as encounter_stop_datetime,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_class,
        -- split code_display into code and description
        split_part(coalesce(code_display, ''), ' | ', 1) as encounter_code,
        nullif(split_part(coalesce(code_display, ''), ' | ', 2), '') as encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_claim_cost as total_encounter_cost,
        payer_coverage as encounter_payer_coverage,
        -- split reason into code and description
        split_part(coalesce(reason, ''), ' | ', 1) as encounter_reason_code,
        nullif(split_part(coalesce(reason, ''), ' | ', 2), '') as encounter_reason_description
    from joined
),

final as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        coalesce(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) as encounter_stop_datetime,
        cast(coalesce(encounter_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) as date) as encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_encounter_cost,
        encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    from parsed
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
with src_enc as (

    select
        id as encounter_id,
        start_date,
        start_time,
        stop_date,
        stop_time,
        patient,
        organization,
        provider,
        payer,
        encounterclass,
        code_display,
        reason
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}

),

src_chg as (

    select
        encounter_id,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_claim_cost,
        payer_coverage
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

),

joined as (

    select
        e.encounter_id,

        -- combine date and time strings into UTC timestamps
        to_timestamp(e.start_date || ' ' || e.start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as encounter_start_datetime,
        to_timestamp(e.stop_date  || ' ' || e.stop_time,  '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as encounter_stop_datetime,

        e.patient       as patient_id,
        e.organization  as organization_id,
        e.provider      as provider_id,
        e.payer         as payer_id,
        e.encounterclass as encounter_class,

        -- split code_display into code and description
        trim(split_part(e.code_display, '|', 1)) as encounter_code,
        trim(split_part(e.code_display, '|', 2)) as encounter_description,

        c.base_encounter_cost,
        c.total_claim_cost      as total_encounter_cost,
        c.payer_coverage        as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- split reason into code and description (may be null)
        case when e.reason is not null then trim(split_part(e.reason, '|', 1)) end as encounter_reason_code,
        case when e.reason is not null then trim(split_part(e.reason, '|', 2)) end as encounter_reason_description

    from src_enc e
    left join src_chg c
        on e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

),

final as (

    select
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date)   as encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        payer_id,
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_encounter_cost,
        encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    from joined
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
WITH

    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        start_date,
        start_time,
        stop_date,
        stop_time,
        patient AS patient_id,
        organization AS organization_id,
        provider AS provider_id,
        payer AS payer_id,
        encounterclass AS encounter_class,
        code_display,
        reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),

raw_chg AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_claim_cost,
        payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.encounter_id,
        -- combine date & time strings (MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS) into timestamps (assumed UTC)
        strptime(e.start_date || ' ' || e.start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS encounter_start_datetime,
        strptime(e.stop_date  || ' ' || e.stop_time , '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        e.patient_id,
        e.organization_id,
        e.provider_id,
        e.payer_id,
        e.encounter_class,
        -- split code_display into code & description
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(e.code_display, '|', 1)) AS encounter_code,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(e.code_display, '|', 2)) AS encounter_description,
        c.base_encounter_cost,

        -- split reason into code & description (may be null)
        CASE WHEN e.reason IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART(e.reason, '|', 1)) END AS encounter_reason_code,
        CASE WHEN e.reason IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART(e.reason, '|', 2)) END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_enc e
    LEFT JOIN raw_chg c
        ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id
)

    encounter_description,
```

```sql
with
    raw_encounters as (
        select *
        from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
    ),

    raw_charges as (
        select *
        from {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}
    ),

    joined as (
        select
            r.id,
            r.start_date,
            r.start_time,
            r.stop_date,
            r.stop_time,
            r.patient,
            r.organization,
            r.provider,
            r.payer,
            r.encounterclass,
            r.code_display,
            r.reason,
            c.base_encounter_cost,
            c.total_claim_cost,
            c.payer_coverage
        from raw_encounters r
        left join raw_charges c
            on r.id = c.encounter_id
    ),

    parsed as (
        select
            id as encounter_id,

            -- combine date and time strings and cast to timestamp (assumed UTC)
            cast(concat(start_date, ' ', start_time) as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
            cast(concat(stop_date, ' ', stop_time) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,

            patient as patient_id,
            organization as organization_id,
            provider as provider_id,
            payer as payer_id,
            encounterclass as encounter_class,

            split_part(code_display, ' | ', 1) as encounter_code,
            split_part(code_display, ' | ', 2) as encounter_description,

            cast(base_encounter_cost as double) as base_encounter_cost,
            cast(total_claim_cost as double) as total_encounter_cost,
            cast(payer_coverage as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,

            split_part(reason, ' | ', 1) as encounter_reason_code,
            split_part(reason, ' | ', 2) as encounter_reason_description
        from joined
    )

select
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date) as encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
from parsed
```

```sql
        to_timestamp(e.start_date || ' ' || e.start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
                                                        AS encounter_start_datetime,
```

```sql
with raw as (

    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}

parsed as (

    select
        -- combine date and time strings into UTC timestamps
        case
            when start_date is not null and start_time is not null
            then strptime(start_date || ' ' || start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
        end as medication_start_datetime,

        case
            when stop_date is not null and stop_time is not null
            then strptime(stop_date || ' ' || stop_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
        end as medication_stop_datetime,

        patient      as patient_id,
        payer        as payer_id,
        encounter    as encounter_id,

        -- code_display is "CODE | DESCRIPTION"
        split_part(code_display, ' | ', 1) as medication_code,
        split_part(code_display, ' | ', 2) as medication_description,

        cast(base_cost as double)          as medication_base_cost,
        cast(payer_coverage as double)    as medication_payer_coverage,
        cast(dispenses as double)         as dispenses,
        cast(totalcost as double)         as medication_total_cost,

        -- reason is "CODE | DESCRIPTION" and may be null
        case when reason is not null then split_part(reason, ' | ', 1) end as medication_reason_code,
        case when reason is not null then split_part(reason, ' | ', 2) end as medication_reason_description

    from raw

),

final as (

        medication_stop_datetime,

        medication_base_cost,
        medication_payer_coverage,
        dispenses,
        medication_total_cost,

        medication_reason_description
    from parsed

)

from final
```

```sql
                strptime(concat(stop_date, ' ', stop_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
