```sql
{{--
stg_acq__medications
--}}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        start_date,
        start_time,
        stop_date,
        stop_time,
        patient,
        payer,
        encounter,
        code_display,
        base_cost,
        payer_coverage,
        dispenses,
        totalcost,
        reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- start datetime & date
        CAST(start_date || ' ' || start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
        CAST(CAST(start_date || ' ' || start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,

        -- stop datetime & date (may be null)
        CASE
            WHEN stop_date IS NOT NULL AND stop_time IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(stop_date || ' ' || stop_time AS TIMESTAMP)
        END AS medication_stop_datetime,
        CASE
            WHEN stop_date IS NOT NULL AND stop_time IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(CAST(stop_date || ' ' || stop_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)
        END AS medication_stop_date,

        -- identifiers
        patient      AS patient_id,
        payer        AS payer_id,
        encounter    AS encounter_id,

        -- code and description
        SPLIT_PART(code_display, ' | ', 1)                                   AS medication_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(code_display, ' | ', 2)), '')                 AS medication_description,

        -- numeric fields
        CAST(base_cost       AS FLOAT)                                      AS medication_base_cost,
        CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT)                                      AS medication_payer_coverage,
        CAST(dispenses      AS FLOAT)                                      AS dispenses,
        CAST(totalcost      AS FLOAT)                                      AS medication_total_cost,

        -- reason code & description
        CASE WHEN reason IS NOT NULL THEN SPLIT_PART(reason, ' | ', 1) END   AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE WHEN reason IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(reason, ' | ', 2)), '') END
                                                                           AS medication_reason_description
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime,
    medication_start_date,
    medication_stop_datetime,
    medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
with
    src as (
        select *
        from {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
    ),

    gender_map as (
        select local_code, standard_value
        from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
        where list_name = 'gender'
    ),

    race_map as (
        select local_code, standard_value
        from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
        where list_name = 'race'
    )

select
    src.id as patient_id,
    src.birthdate as birth_date,
    src.deathdate as death_date,
    src.ssn,
    src.drivers as drivers_license_number,
    src.passport as passport_number,
    src.prefix as patient_prefix,
    src.first as patient_first_name,
    src.last as patient_last_name,
    src.suffix as patient_suffix,
    src.maiden as maiden_name,

    -- marital_status: raw uses '1' for married, '0' (or other) for single
    case
        when src.marital = '1' then 'M'
        when src.marital = '0' then 'S'
        else src.marital
    end as marital_status,

    -- race: map via code_map when available, otherwise keep raw value
    coalesce(rm.standard_value, src.race) as race,

    -- gender: map via code_map when available, otherwise first character uppercased
    coalesce(gm.standard_value, upper(substr(src.gender, 1, 1))) as patient_gender,

    src.birthplace,
    src.address as patient_address,
    src.city as patient_city,
    src.state as patient_state,
    src.county as patient_county,
    src.zip as patient_zip,
    src.lat as patient_latitude,
    src.lon as patient_longitude,
    cast(src.healthcare_expenses as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(src.healthcare_coverage as float) as healthcare_coverage

from src
left join gender_map gm
    on gm.local_code = src.gender
left join race_map rm
    on rm.local_code = src.race
```

```sql
with raw as (
    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d3', 'patients') }}
),

gender_map as (
    select local_code, standard_value
    from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    where list_name = 'gender'
),

    select local_code, standard_value
    from {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    where list_name = 'race'
),

final as (
    select
        Id as patient_id,
        cast(BIRTHDATE as date) as birth_date,
        cast(DEATHDATE as date) as death_date,
        SSN as ssn,
        DRIVERS as drivers_license_number,
        PASSPORT as passport_number,
        PREFIX as patient_prefix,
        FIRST as patient_first_name,
        LAST as patient_last_name,

        case
            when MARITAL = '1' then 'M'   -- 1 = married
            when MARITAL = '2' then 'S'   -- 2 = single (fallback)

        coalesce(race_map.standard_value, RACE) as race,
        ETHNICITY as ethnicity,
        gender_map.standard_value as patient_gender,
        BIRTHPLACE as birthplace,
        ADDRESS as patient_address,
        CITY as patient_city,
        STATE as patient_state,
        COUNTY as patient_county,

        cast(LAT as double) as patient_latitude,
        cast(LON as double) as patient_longitude,
        cast(HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES as double) as healthcare_expenses,
        cast(HEALTHCARE_COVERAGE as double) as healthcare_coverage
    from raw
    left join gender_map on raw.GENDER = gender_map.local_code
    left join race_map   on raw.RACE   = race_map.local_code
)

from final
```

```sql
WITH raw_enc AS (
    SELECT
        "Id" AS encounter_id,
        CAST("START" AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST("STOP" AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        "PATIENT" AS patient_id,
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        "PROVIDER" AS provider_id,
        "PAYER" AS payer_id,
        "ENCOUNTERCLASS" AS raw_encounter_class,
        "CODE" AS encounter_code,
        "DESCRIPTION" AS encounter_description,
        "BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS base_encounter_cost,
        "TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS total_encounter_cost,
        "PAYER_COVERAGE" AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        "REASONCODE" AS encounter_reason_code,
        "REASONDESCRIPTION" AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }}
),

class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        raw_enc.encounter_id,
        raw_enc.encounter_start_datetime,
        raw_enc.encounter_stop_datetime,
        raw_enc.patient_id,
        raw_enc.organization_id,
        raw_enc.provider_id,
        raw_enc.payer_id,
        COALESCE(cm.standard_value, raw_enc.raw_encounter_class) AS encounter_class,
        raw_enc.encounter_code,
        raw_enc.encounter_description,
        raw_enc.base_encounter_cost,
        raw_enc.total_encounter_cost,
        raw_enc.encounter_payer_coverage,
        raw_enc.encounter_reason_code,
        raw_enc.encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_enc
    LEFT JOIN class_map cm
        ON raw_enc.raw_encounter_class = cm.local_code
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    COALESCE(
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM joined
```

```sql
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        "Id",
        {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("START")) }} AS encounter_start_datetime,
        {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("STOP")) }} AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        "PATIENT",
        "ORGANIZATION",
        "PROVIDER",
        "PAYER",
        "ENCOUNTERCLASS",
        "CODE",
        "DESCRIPTION",
        "BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST",
        "TOTAL_CLAIM_COST",
        "PAYER_COVERAGE",
        "REASONCODE",
        "REASONDESCRIPTION"
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }}
),

class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),

mapped AS (
    SELECT
        "Id" AS encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        "PATIENT" AS patient_id,
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        "PROVIDER" AS provider_id,
        "PAYER" AS payer_id,
        cm.standard_value AS encounter_class,
        TRIM(LEADING 'SCT:' FROM "CODE") AS encounter_code,
        "DESCRIPTION" AS encounter_description,
        "BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS base_encounter_cost,
        "TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS total_encounter_cost,
        "PAYER_COVERAGE" AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        CASE WHEN "REASONCODE" IS NOT NULL
             THEN TRIM(LEADING 'SCT:' FROM "REASONCODE")
        END AS encounter_reason_code,
        "REASONDESCRIPTION" AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src
    LEFT JOIN class_map cm
        ON src."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = cm.local_code
),

    SELECT
        encounter_id,

        encounter_description,
        base_encounter_cost,
        total_encounter_cost,
        encounter_payer_coverage,
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM mapped
)

FROM final
```

```sql
{{--
stg_acq__procedures
Transforms raw_d3.procedures into the staging contract expected by the
acquirer. All columns are returned with the exact names, order and data
types of `stg_synthea__procedures`. The source timestamps (with time zone)
are cast to naive timestamps; codes are stripped of any system prefix
(e.g., “SCT:”). Null reason fields are preserved.
--}}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'procedures') }}
),

renamed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST("START" AS TIMESTAMP)                                 AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST("STOP"  AS TIMESTAMP)                                 AS procedure_stop_datetime,

        END                                                         AS procedure_reason_code,
```

```sql
        CAST(CAST("DATE" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS observation_date,
        "PATIENT" AS patient_id,
        "ENCOUNTER" AS encounter_id,
        "CATEGORY" AS observation_category,
        REGEXP_REPLACE("CODE", '^LN:', '') AS observation_code,
        "DESCRIPTION" AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g'     THEN printf('%.1f', CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 1000)
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm'     THEN printf('%.1f', CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) * 100)
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L' THEN printf('%.1f', CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 10)
            ELSE "VALUE"
        END AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g'     THEN 'kg'
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm'     THEN 'cm'
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L' THEN 'mg/dL'
            ELSE "UNITS"
        END AS observation_units,
        "TYPE" AS observation_value_type
    FROM src
)
```

```sql
        "PATIENT"                                                     AS patient_id,
        "ENCOUNTER"                                                   AS encounter_id,

        CASE

        "UNITS"                                                       AS raw_units,
        "TYPE"                                                        AS observation_value_type
    FROM src

),

converted AS (

    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN raw_units = 'g'      THEN printf('%.1f', CAST(raw_value AS DOUBLE) / 1000)
            WHEN raw_units = 'm'      THEN printf('%.1f', CAST(raw_value AS DOUBLE) * 100)
            WHEN raw_units = 'mg/L'   THEN printf('%.1f', CAST(raw_value AS DOUBLE) / 10)
            ELSE raw_value
        END                                                       AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN raw_units = 'g'      THEN 'kg'
            WHEN raw_units = 'm'      THEN 'cm'
            WHEN raw_units = 'mg/L'   THEN 'mg/dL'
            ELSE raw_units
        END                                                       AS observation_units,

    FROM renamed

),

    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        observation_value,
        observation_units,
```

```sql
        m.person_id
        , m.measurement_source_value
        , m.value_as_number

            order by m.measurement_datetime desc, m.value_as_number desc
```

```sql
        TRY_CAST("Claim service start date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,

        -- identifiers

        -- medication codes / description
        "National drug code"               AS medication_code,
        COALESCE("Procedure description", NULL) AS medication_description,

        -- cost / coverage fields (strings to numeric, empty strings become NULL)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Drug cost", '')                     AS DOUBLE) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Claim primary payer paid amount", '') AS DOUBLE) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Quantity dispensed", '')            AS DOUBLE) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Line payment amount", '')          AS DOUBLE) AS medication_total_cost,

        -- reason (diagnosis) fields
        "Diagnosis code"        AS medication_reason_code,
```

- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- The three cost columns are in raw_d2.encounter_charges, joined on encounter_id = id.
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.

```sql
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),

raw_cost AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.id                                            AS encounter_id,
        -- combine date and time strings into UTC timestamps
        to_timestamp(e.start_date || ' ' || e.start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
                                                        AS encounter_start_datetime,
        to_timestamp(e.stop_date  || ' ' || e.stop_time , '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
                                                        AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        e.patient                                       AS patient_id,
        e.organization                                  AS organization_id,
        e.provider                                      AS provider_id,
        e.payer                                         AS payer_id,
        e.encounterclass                                AS encounter_class,
        -- split code_display into code and description
        split_part(e.code_display, ' | ', 1)            AS encounter_code,
        split_part(e.code_display, ' | ', 2)            AS encounter_description,
        c.base_encounter_cost,
        c.total_claim_cost                              AS total_encounter_cost,
        c.payer_coverage                               AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        -- split reason into code and description (may be null)
        CASE
            WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE split_part(e.reason, ' | ', 1)
        END                                            AS encounter_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE split_part(e.reason, ' | ', 2)
        END                                            AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_enc e
    LEFT JOIN raw_cost c
        ON e.id = c.encounter_id
)
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop dates are the first 10 characters of onsetDateTime and abatementDateTime (the local date, not the UTC date).
- patient is subject.reference and the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), both without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0].code and .display; the acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space.

## Your previous model
```sql
{{--
  Model: stg_acq__conditions
  Purpose: Transform raw FHIR Condition resources into the staging contract used by the acquirer.
--}}

WITH raw_conditions AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
)

SELECT
    -- start date: first 10 characters of onsetDateTime (UTC date)
    CAST(
        SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'), 1, 10)
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_start_date,

    -- stop date: first 10 characters of abatementDateTime, if present
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') IS NOT NULL
            THEN SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime'), 1, 10)
        END
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_stop_date,

    -- patient identifier: strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
        'urn:uuid:',
        ''
    ) AS patient_id,

    -- encounter identifier: strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
        'urn:uuid:',
        ''
    ) AS encounter_id,

    -- SNOMED code (first coding entry)
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code,

    -- description: first coding display, commas replaced by spaces
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS condition_description

FROM raw_conditions
```

```sql
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as period_end,

        -- references
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')          as patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') as provider_ref,

        -- classification and type
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                as encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')    as encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_description,

        -- reason
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')    as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_desc

        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates derived from timestamps
        cast(period_start as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as date) as encounter_stop_date,
```

```sql
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,

        json_extract_string(res, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(

            json_extract_string(res, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueString')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) = 0
),

-- Observations that contain a component array – one row per component
obs_with_component AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(res, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text')

        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString')

        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
        resource                                                                                AS full_resource
    FROM source
),

component_rows AS (

        b.observation_datetime,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        json_extract(comp, '$.code.coding[0].code')                                            AS observation_code,
        json_extract(comp, '$.code.text')                                                     AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                printf('%.1f', CAST(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            ELSE
                json_extract(comp, '$.valueString')
        END                                                                                 AS observation_value_raw,
        json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.unit')                                            AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                                 AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT json_extract(b.full_resource, '$.component[' || i || ']') AS comp
        FROM range(0, json_array_length(json_extract(b.full_resource, '$.component')) - 1) AS t(i)
    ) AS c ON TRUE
),

simple_rows AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        patient_id,
        encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        main_code                                 AS observation_code,
        main_description                          AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN
                printf('%.1f', CAST(main_value_quantity AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN value_codeable_type = 'OBJECT' THEN main_value_codeable_display
            ELSE main_value_string
        END                                      AS observation_value_raw,
        main_units                                AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                      AS observation_value_type
    FROM base
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(full_resource, '$.component')) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(json_extract(full_resource, '$.component')) = 0
)

SELECT

    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE)               AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,

    REPLACE(observation_value_raw, ',', ' ')         AS observation_value,
    REPLACE(observation_units, ',', ' ')             AS observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM component_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM simple_rows
) AS final
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

## Your previous model
```sql
{{--
stg_acq__encounters
Maps raw FHIR R4 Encounter resources into the acquirer’s staging contract.
--}}

with

raw_enc as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

-- extract primitive fields from the JSON payload
extracted as (
    select
        encounter_id,

        -- patient reference without the urn:uuid: prefix
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        -- period start / end timestamps (ISO8601 with offset)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')          as start_iso,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')            as end_iso,

        -- class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')           as class_code,

        -- encounter type coding (first element)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        -- reason code / description (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display,

        -- service provider reference (contains org id after a '|')
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as service_provider_ref,

        -- primary participant display (contains provider name prefixed with "Dr. ")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as participant_display
    from raw_enc
),

-- resolve organization_id and provider_id
joined as (
    select
        e.*,

        -- organization_id: text after the final pipe character
        regexp_extract(e.service_provider_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$', 1) as organization_id,

        -- provider name without leading "Dr. " (trim whitespace)
        trim(regexp_replace(e.participant_display, '^Dr\\.\\s*', '')) as provider_name
    from extracted e
),

-- lookup provider_id using name + organization match
provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as organization_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

-- bring everything together and compute derived columns
final as (
    select
        j.encounter_id,

        -- timestamps converted to UTC (DuckDB to_timestamp handles the offset)
        to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_start_datetime,
        to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates (date part of timestamps)
        cast(to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        j.patient_id,
        j.organization_id,

        -- provider_id via name + organization join; if not found, return NULL
        prov.provider_id,

        -- payer information not present in FHIR; set NULL
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,

        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when j.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when j.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when j.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when j.type_code in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when j.type_code in ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,

        -- code & description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.type_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.type_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        -- cost columns – not available, return NULL
        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description

    from joined j
    left join provider_lookup prov
        on lower(j.provider_name) = prov.provider_name_lc
        and j.organization_id = prov.organization_id
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
                THEN SPLIT_PART(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS DATE
        )                                                                                     AS death_date,

        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
               AND JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')                    AS ssn,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')                        AS drivers_license_number,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')                       AS passport_number,

        -- name components (official name)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')                                   AS patient_prefix,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                                    AS patient_first_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].family')                                      AS patient_last_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')                                   AS patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (use = maiden)
        (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.family')

        -- marital status code
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                       AS marital_status,

        -- race and ethnicity (text value is second element of the inner extension array)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString')             AS race,

        -- gender to single‑letter code
        CASE LOWER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))

            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))
        END                                                                                  AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace concatenated as "city  state  country"
        CONCAT_WS('  ',
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                                     AS birthplace,

        -- address fields (use first address entry)
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.address[0].line'), ', ')                    AS patient_address,
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH raw_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}

        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP)      AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   AS TIMESTAMP)      AS encounter_stop_datetime_raw,

        -- References
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')                     AS patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference')             AS org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference')   AS provider_ref,

        -- Core encounter data
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                             AS encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')                 AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        )                                                                          AS encounter_description,

        -- Reason (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')               AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display')            AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM raw_encounters
),

transformed AS (
    SELECT
        -- IDs
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(encounter_stop_datetime_raw, encounter_start_datetime)          AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        REPLACE(patient_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '')                                     AS patient_id,

        CASE
            WHEN org_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION('|' IN org_ref) > 0 THEN SPLIT_PART(org_ref, '|', 2)
            ELSE REPLACE(org_ref, 'Organization?identifier=', '')
        END                                                                       AS organization_id,

        CASE
            WHEN provider_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION('|' IN provider_ref) > 0 THEN SPLIT_PART(provider_ref, '|', 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                       AS provider_id,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                                     AS payer_id,

        -- Core encounter attributes
        encounter_class,
        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,

        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- Reason fields
        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT

    encounter_start_datetime,

FROM transformed
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as timestamp) as encounter_end_raw,

        -- patient reference without the urn:uuid: prefix
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization id from serviceProvider.reference (after the '|')
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2) as organization_id,

        -- class code (e.g., EMER, IMP, AMB)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code,

        -- primary encounter type code / description
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        -- reason (if present)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display_raw,

    from raw_encounters
),

),

    from extracted e
),

joined as (
    select
        m.encounter_id,

        -- timestamps
        m.encounter_start_datetime,
        coalesce(m.encounter_end_raw, m.encounter_start_datetime) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates
        cast(m.encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(coalesce(m.encounter_end_raw, m.encounter_start_datetime) as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        m.organization_id,

        p.provider_id,

        null::varchar as payer_id,

            when m.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
```

```sql
WITH source_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,

        -- datetime fields (UTC, naive)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- date parts
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS encounter_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (urn:uuid:<id>)
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), ':', 3) AS patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (extract after final '|')
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') LIKE '%|%' THEN
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                    '\\|([^|]+)$',
                    1
                )
            ELSE
                split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '/', -1)
        END AS organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract NPI after '|')
        regexp_extract(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- payer not present in FHIR Encounter
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,

        -- encounter type code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,

        -- description: prefer text, else display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS encounter_description,

        -- cost fields not present
        NULL::DOUBLE AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (may be missing)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description

    FROM source_encounters
)

SELECT
```

```sql
            when r.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when r.type_code = '702927004' then 'urgentcare'
                    when r.type_code in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,
        -- code and description (commas replaced by spaces)
        r.type_code as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(r.type_display, r.type_text), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,
        -- cost columns are not available – cast to FLOAT per contract
        cast(null as float) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as float) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as float) as encounter_payer_coverage,
        -- reason code and description
        r.reason_code as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(r.reason_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description
    from raw_enc r
    left join provider_map pm
        on lower(regexp_replace(r.provider_display, '^Dr\.\\s*', '')) = pm.name_lc
        and pm.org_id = regexp_extract(r.org_ref, '\\|(.*)$', 1)
)

select
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date) as encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
from final
```

```sql
/*

Transform raw FHIR STU3 Patient resources into the staging contract.

WITH source AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- patient identifier
        id AS patient_id,

        -- dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            NULLIF(
                SPLIT_PART(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1),
                ''
            )
            AS DATE
        ) AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "SB")].value'
        ) AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value'
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value'
        ) AS passport_number,

        -- name parts
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]'
        ) AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]'
        ) AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family'
        ) AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]'
        ) AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family'
        ) AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code'
        ) AS marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (use the human‑readable text if present)
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
            )
        ) AS race,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
            )
        ) AS ethnicity,

        -- gender converted to the single‑letter code used by the synthea model
        CASE LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city state country concatenated)
        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country'
            )
        ) AS birthplace,

        -- address components (use first address entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,

        -- geolocation
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_longitude,

        -- financial columns – not present in the FHIR payload
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM source
)

    SELECT
```
```sql
        id AS patient_id,

        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            NULLIF(
                SPLIT_PART(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1),
                ''
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS death_date,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "SB")].value') AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value') AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value') AS passport_number,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family') AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family') AS maiden_name,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,

        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS race,

        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS ethnicity,

        CASE LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END AS patient_gender,

        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country')
        ) AS birthplace,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,

        CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_longitude,

        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM source
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed
```

```sql
                THEN CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS DATE)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS death_date,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="SB")].value') AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="DL")].value') AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="PPN")].value') AS passport_number,

        -- name fields
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].family') AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="official")].suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="maiden")].family') AS maiden_name,

        -- demographic / status
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[1].valueString') AS race,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[1].valueString') AS ethnicity,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender') AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city, state, country concatenated)
        TRIM(
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'), '') || ', ' ||
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'), '') || ', ' ||
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country'), '')
        ) AS birthplace,

        -- address
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,

        -- geolocation
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="latitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="longitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_longitude,

        -- financial (not present in FHIR)
        NULL AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL AS healthcare_coverage

    FROM src
)

SELECT *
FROM extracted
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.

```sql
with
-- extract procedure level fields
proc as (
    select
        -- start / stop timestamps (fallback to performedDateTime if period missing)
        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) as timestamp
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        replace(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        replace(json_extract(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as encounter_id,

        -- procedure coding
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as procedure_code,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as procedure_description,

        -- cost not present in FHIR Procedure – set to NULL (float)
        null::double as procedure_base_cost,

        -- first reasonReference id (if any) – strip prefix for join to Condition
        replace(
            json_extract(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

-- extract condition level fields needed for procedure reasons
cond as (

        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as reason_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
)

select

    proc.procedure_base_cost,
    cond.reason_code as procedure_reason_code,

from proc
```

```sql
  Source: raw_fhir_stu3.patient (id, resource JSON)
  Purpose: Transform FHIR STU3 Patient resources into the staging contract
--}}

with raw as (
    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract identifiers (SSN, DL, PPN)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
identifiers as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')                     as identifier_value,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code')       as identifier_code
    from raw r
    left join lateral json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.identifier')) i on true
),

ssn as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'SB' then identifier_value end) as ssn
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

drivers as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'DL' then identifier_value end) as drivers_license_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

passports as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'PPN' then identifier_value end) as passport_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract names (official & maiden)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
names as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.prefix[0]')               as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.given[0]')                as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.family')                  as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.suffix[0]')               as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(maiden.value, '$.family')               as maiden_name
    from raw r
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
        limit 1
    ) off on true
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
        limit 1
    ) maiden on true
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core patient fields
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
core as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.birthDate') as date)                                   as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
                then cast(substr(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'),1,10) as date)
        end                                                                                           as death_date,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                              as marital_status,
        case lower(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end                                                                                           as patient_gender,
        -- race (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as race_raw,
        -- ethnicity (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as ethnicity_raw,
        -- birthplace: city  state  country
        concat_ws('  ',
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                                               as birthplace,
        -- address fields
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')                                         as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].city')                                            as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].state')                                           as address_state,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                                      as patient_zip,
        -- latitude / longitude from geolocation extension
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_longitude
    from raw r
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map state abbreviation to full name
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
states as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Final projection matching the staging contract
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
final as (
    select
        c.patient_id,
        c.birth_date,
        c.death_date,
        s.ssn,
        d.drivers_license_number,
        p.passport_number,
        n.patient_prefix,
        n.patient_first_name,
        n.patient_last_name,
        n.patient_suffix,
        n.maiden_name,
        c.marital_status,
        case lower(c.race_raw)
            when 'white'                                 then 'white'
            when 'black or african american'            then 'black'
            when 'asian'                                 then 'asian'
            when 'american indian or alaska native'     then 'native'
            when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end                                            as race,
        case
            when lower(c.ethnicity_raw) like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end                                            as ethnicity,
        c.patient_gender,
        c.birthplace,
        c.patient_address,
        c.patient_city,
        coalesce(st.state_name, c.address_state)      as patient_state,
        cast(null as varchar)                         as patient_county,
        c.patient_zip,
        c.patient_latitude,
        c.patient_longitude,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_expenses,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_coverage
    from core c
    left join ssn s          on s.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join drivers d      on d.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join passports p    on p.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join names n        on n.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join states st      on st.state_abbreviation = c.address_state
)

select *
from final
```

```sql
Transforms acquired claims data into the staging contract for medications.

with raw as (
    select
        -- Date fields (strings in YYYY-MM-DD format)
        "Service (from) date" as service_from_date,
        "Service to date"       as service_to_date,

        -- Identifiers
        "Patient account number" as patient_id,

        -- Medication details
        "National drug code" as medication_code,
        null::varchar        as medication_description,

        -- Cost fields (stored as VARCHAR, may be empty)
        nullif("Drug cost", '')                     as drug_cost,
        nullif("Claim primary payer paid amount", '') as payer_paid_amount,
        nullif("Line payment amount", '')           as line_payment_amount,

        -- Dispense count
        nullif("Quantity dispensed", '') as quantity_dispensed,

        -- Reason for medication
        nullif("Diagnosis code", '')        as medication_reason_code,
        nullif("Diagnosis description", '') as medication_reason_description
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
)

select
    -- Start datetime and date (midnight UTC)
    cast(service_from_date as timestamp)          as medication_start_datetime,
    cast(service_from_date as date)               as medication_start_date,

    -- Stop datetime and date (null if placeholder)
    case
        when service_to_date = '1969-12-31' then null
        else cast(service_to_date as timestamp)
    end                                           as medication_stop_datetime,
    case
        when service_to_date = '1969-12-31' then null
        else cast(service_to_date as date)
    end                                           as medication_stop_date,

    -- Identifiers
    patient_id,
    null::varchar                                 as payer_id,
    null::varchar                                 as encounter_id,

    -- Medication code / description
    medication_code,
    medication_description,

    -- Monetary values
    cast(drug_cost as double)                     as medication_base_cost,
```

```sql
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        resource::json AS res
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

obs_no_component AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(res, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(res, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(res, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(res, '$.valueString')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(res, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) = 0
),

obs_with_component AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(res, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_ref,
        json_extract_string(res, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.value')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueString')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract(comp.value, '$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM raw
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(json_extract(res, '$.component')) AS comp(value) ON TRUE
    WHERE json_array_length(json_extract(res, '$.component')) > 0
),

all_obs AS (
    SELECT * FROM obs_no_component
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM obs_with_component
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    REPLACE(subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
    REPLACE(encounter_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM all_obs
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
