```sql
{# stg_acq__encounters: map raw FHIR R4 Encounter resources into the acquirer’s staging contract #}

with

raw_enc as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        encounter_id,

        -- patient id without the "urn:uuid:" prefix
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as start_iso,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as end_iso,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as service_provider_ref,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as participant_display
    from raw_enc
),

joined as (
    select
        e.*,
        -- organization_id is the value after the final pipe in the reference
        regexp_extract(e.service_provider_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$', 1) as organization_id,
        -- provider name without leading "Dr. "
        trim(regexp_replace(e.participant_display, '^Dr\\.\\s*', '')) as provider_name
    from extracted e
),

provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as organization_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

final as (
    select
        j.encounter_id,

        to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_start_date,

        to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_stop_datetime,
        cast(to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_stop_date,
```

```sql
        j.patient_id,
        j.organization_id,

        prov.provider_id,

        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,

        case
            when j.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when j.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when j.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when j.type_code in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when j.type_code in ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,

        replace(j.type_code, ',', ' ') as encounter_code,
        replace(j.type_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,

        replace(j.reason_code, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(j.reason_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description

    from joined j
    left join provider_lookup prov
        on lower(j.provider_name) = prov.provider_name_lc
        and j.organization_id = prov.organization_id
)

select *
from final
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
        CASE

            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                              AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
```

```sql
        CAST(json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')) AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        REPLACE(json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference')), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.encounter.reference')), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,
        json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'))               AS observation_category,
        json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'))                     AS main_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.code.text')),
            json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'))
        )                                                                                AS main_description,
        json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')                                 AS main_value_quantity,
        json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'))                    AS main_units,
        json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueQuantity'))                             AS value_quantity_type,
        json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')) AS main_value_codeable_display,
        json_unquote(json_extract(resource, '$.valueString'))                           AS main_value_string,
        json_type(json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept'))                      AS value_codeable_type,
        json_extract(resource, '$.component')                                           AS component_array
    FROM source
),

component_rows AS (
    SELECT
        b.observation_datetime,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.code.coding[0].code'))                               AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.code.text')),
            json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.code.coding[0].display'))
        )                                                                                      AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                printf('%.1f', CAST(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept')) = 'OBJECT' THEN
                json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'))
            ELSE
                json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.valueString'))
        END                                                                                     AS observation_value_raw,
        json_unquote(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity.unit'))                                AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_type(json_extract(comp, '$.valueQuantity')) = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                                                     AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT json_extract(b.component_array, '$[' || i || ']') AS comp
        FROM range(0, COALESCE(CAST(json_array_length(b.component_array) AS BIGINT) - 1, -1)) AS t(i)
        WHERE json_array_length(b.component_array) > 0
    ) AS c ON TRUE
),

simple_rows AS (
    SELECT
        b.observation_datetime,
        b.patient_id,
        b.encounter_id,
        b.observation_category,
        b.main_code                                            AS observation_code,
        b.main_description                                     AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN b.value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN printf('%.1f', CAST(b.main_value_quantity AS DOUBLE))
            WHEN b.value_codeable_type = 'OBJECT' THEN b.main_value_codeable_display
            ELSE b.main_value_string
        END                                                    AS observation_value_raw,
        b.main_units                                           AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN b.value_quantity_type = 'OBJECT' THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END                                                    AS observation_value_type
    FROM base b
    WHERE json_array_length(b.component_array) IS NULL
       OR json_array_length(b.component_array) = 0
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    REPLACE(observation_description, ',', ' ') AS observation_description,
    REPLACE(observation_value_raw, ',', ' ')   AS observation_value,
    REPLACE(observation_units, ',', ' ')      AS observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM component_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM simple_rows
) AS final
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

## Your previous model
```sql
with
raw_enc as (
    select
        -- encounter identifier
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as encounter_id,

        -- start / stop timestamps (UTC, stored as timestamp without time zone)
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- patient identifier (remove leading urn:uuid:)
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization identifier from serviceProvider.reference (after the pipe)
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '|', 2) as organization_id,

        -- raw class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code_raw,

        -- first type coding code (used for class mapping and encounter code)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') as type_code_raw,

        -- encounter description (prefer coding display, fallback to type text)
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) as encounter_description_raw,

        -- reason code / description (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') as encounter_reason_code_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_reason_description_raw,

        -- participant display (e.g., "Dr. John Doe") – strip leading “Dr.” and trim
        trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\\.\\s*',
            ''
        )) as provider_display_clean
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as org_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

joined as (
    select
        e.*,
        pl.provider_id
    from raw_enc e
    left join provider_lookup pl
        on pl.provider_name_lc = lower(e.provider_display_clean)
        and pl.org_id = e.organization_id
),

final as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(encounter_start_datetime as date) as encounter_start_date,
        encounter_stop_datetime,
        cast(encounter_stop_datetime as date) as encounter_stop_date,
        patient_id,
        organization_id,
        provider_id,
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,
        case
            when class_code_raw = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when class_code_raw = 'IMP' then 'inpatient'
            when class_code_raw = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when type_code_raw in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when type_code_raw in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,
        type_code_raw as encounter_code,
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state') as birth_state,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country') as birth_country
    from raw_patients rp
),

-- address and geolocation (using first address entry)
address_info as (
    select
        rp.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.address[0].city') as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.address[0].state') as patient_state_abbr,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') as patient_zip,
        json_extract_float(rp.resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[0].valueDecimal') as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_float(rp.resource, '$.address[0].extension[0].extension[1].valueDecimal') as patient_longitude
    from raw_patients rp
),

-- other scalar fields
scalar_fields as (
    select
        rp.patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
            then cast(substr(json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'),1,10) as date)
            else null
        end as death_date,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status_raw,
        json_extract_string(rp.resource, '$.gender') as gender_raw
    from raw_patients rp
),

-- combine everything
combined as (
    select
        sf.patient_id,
        sf.birth_date,
        sf.death_date,
        idf.ssn,
        idf.drivers_license_number,
        idf.passport_number,
        oname.patient_prefix,
        oname.patient_first_name,
        oname.patient_last_name,
        oname.patient_suffix,
        mn.maiden_name,
        sf.marital_status_raw as marital_status,
        case
            when reb.race_display = 'white' then 'white'
            when reb.race_display = 'black or african american' then 'black'
            when reb.race_display = 'asian' then 'asian'
            when reb.race_display = 'american indian or alaska native' then 'native'
            when reb.race_display = 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end as race,
        case
            when reb.ethnicity_display like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end as ethnicity,
        case sf.gender_raw
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as patient_gender,
        concat_ws('  ', reb.birth_city, reb.birth_state, reb.birth_country) as birthplace,
        ai.patient_address,
        ai.patient_city,
        map.state_name as patient_state,
        null as patient_county,
        ai.patient_zip,
        ai.patient_latitude,
        ai.patient_longitude,
        null as healthcare_expenses,
        null as healthcare_coverage
    from scalar_fields sf
    left join identifiers idf on idf.patient_id = sf.patient_id
    left join official_name oname on oname.patient_id = sf.patient_id
    left join maiden_name mn on mn.patient_id = sf.patient_id
    left join race_ethnicity_birthplace reb on reb.patient_id = sf.patient_id
    left join address_info ai on ai.patient_id = sf.patient_id
    left join {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} map
        on map.state_abbreviation = ai.patient_state_abbr
)

select *
from combined
```

```sql
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        id AS patient_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

identifiers AS (
    SELECT
        r.patient_id,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.system') AS id_system,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') AS id_code,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.value') AS id_value
    FROM raw r
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(r.resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
),

agg_ids AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn' AND id_code = 'SS' THEN id_value END) AS ssn,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_code = 'DL' THEN id_value END) AS drivers_license_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN id_code = 'PPN' THEN id_value END) AS passport_number
    FROM identifiers
    GROUP BY patient_id
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        r.patient_id,

        -- birth / death dates
        CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NOT NULL
                THEN SPLIT_PART(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS DATE
        ) AS death_date,

        -- identifiers from agg_ids
        ids.ssn,
        ids.drivers_license_number,
        ids.passport_number,

        -- name components (official name)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')               AS patient_prefix,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                AS patient_first_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.name[0].family')                  AS patient_last_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')               AS patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (use = maiden)
        (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.family')
         FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(r.resource, '$.name')) AS n
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.use') = 'maiden'
         LIMIT 1)                                                          AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status code
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')   AS marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (text value is second inner extension)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString') AS race,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString') AS ethnicity,

        -- gender to single‑letter code
        CASE LOWER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male'   THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.gender'))
        END                                                                AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace concatenated as "city  state  country"
        CONCAT_WS('  ',
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.city'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_string(r.resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.state'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_string(r.resource, '$.extension[4].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                    AS birthplace,

        -- address fields (first address entry)
        ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT(r.resource, '$.address[0].line'), ', ') AS patient_address,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.address[0].city')               AS patient_city,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(r.resource, '$.address[0].state')              AS patient_state_abbr,
```

```sql
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- start / stop dates
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS encounter_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (extract UUID from "urn:uuid:<id>")
        split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), ':', 3) AS patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (extract after final '|', fallback to last path segment)
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') LIKE '%|%' THEN
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                    '\\|([^|]+)$',
                    1
                )
            ELSE
                split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '/', -1)
        END AS organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract NPI after '|')
        regexp_extract(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- payer not present in Encounter resource
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

)
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
            json_extract(resource, '$.performedDateTime')

        -- patient and encounter identifiers (strip the urn:uuid: prefix)
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id,
        REPLACE(json_extract(resource, '$.context.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id,

        -- procedure code and description (prefer coding display, fallback to text)
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description,

        -- first reason reference (may be NULL)
        json_extract(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_ref_raw
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

    FROM raw_procedures
),

condition_lookup AS (
```

- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.
